title: E-commerce Executive
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION E-commerce Executive / Manager Industry: Leather Bags, Handbags & Accessories Location: Kolkata Department: E-commerce Employment Type: Full- time Job Purpose We are looking for a responsible and result-oriented E-commerce Executive / Manager to manage and grow our online sales business for leather bags and accessories. The candidate will be responsible for day-to-day marketplace operations, inventory management, order processing, sales reporting, advertising coordination and profitability analysis. The candidate should be comfortable working with marketplace dashboards, Excel and business reports, and should have a strong understanding of e-commerce operations. Key Responsibilities Marketplace Management Manage day-to-day operations of Amazon seller accounts, particularly Amazon USA. Monitor account health, order status, listing performance and marketplace notifications. Ensure product listings are accurate, complete and up to date. Coordinate product uploads, titles, descriptions, keywords, images and pricing updates. Monitor suppressed listings, policy issues and account performance notifications. Coordinate with marketplace support to resolve operational issues. Sales and Business Growth Monitor daily, weekly and monthly sales performance. Analyse sales by SKU, product category and marketplace. Identify best-selling, slow-moving and underperforming products. Recommend pricing, promotions and sales improvement initiatives. Coordinate product launches and seasonal promotions. Track sales targets and prepare performance reports. Inventory and Order Management Maintain SKU-wise inventory records and reconcile stock with marketplace reports. Monitor stock availability in Amazon fulfilment centres and the companys warehouse. Identify stock-outs, excess stock and slow-moving inventory. Coordinate replenishment with the manufacturing and warehouse teams. Monitor order fulfilment, cancellations, shipment delays and inventory discrepancies. Maintain accurate records of damaged, returned and unsellable stock. Returns, Refunds and Reimbursements Monitor customer returns, refunds and return reasons. Track returned inventory and coordinate physical inspection where applicable. Identify eligible reimbursement claims for lost, damaged or incorrectly handled inventory. Follow up on outstanding claims and maintain a claim tracker. Analyse return trends and recommend corrective actions to reduce losses. Advertising and Marketing Monitor Amazon advertising campaigns, budgets and performance. Track advertising spend, attributed sales, ACoS and ROAS. Coordinate with advertising agencies or specialists where required. Recommend improvements to campaigns, product visibility and conversion rates. Coordinate promotions, coupons and discounts within approved budgets. Profitability and Financial Reporting Prepare SKU-wise profitability reports. Track selling price, product cost, marketplace fees, fulfilment charges, advertising expenses, refunds and other relevant costs. Monitor marketplace settlements and reconcile payments with bank receipts. Coordinate with the accounts team for recording transactions in Tally. Prepare weekly sales and profitability summaries and monthly e-commerce P&L reports. Identify loss-making products and recommend corrective measures. Reporting and Coordination Prepare daily, weekly and monthly e-commerce reports. Maintain trackers for sales, inventory, returns, advertising and unresolved issues. Coordinate with manufacturing, warehouse, logistics, marketing and accounts teams. Highlight important business risks, pending decisions and financial discrepancies to management. Use Excel and AI tools to improve reporting, analysis and operational efficiency. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Achievement of sales targets. Improvement in contribution profit and SKU-wise profitability. Inventory accuracy and reduction in stock- outs. Timely order processing and reduction in avoidable cancellations. Control of advertising expenditure and campaign performance. Timely resolution of returns, claims and account issues. Accuracy and timeliness of daily, weekly and monthly reports. Marketplace account health and listing availability. Timely reconciliation of marketplace settlements. Targets should be set according to the existing business baseline and reviewed monthly. Required Qualifications and Experience Graduate in commerce, business administration, marketing or a related field. Ideally 2-5 years of hands-on e-commerce experience. Experience managing Amazon seller accounts is essential for an Amazon-focused role. Experience with Amazon USA will be an advantage. Strong knowledge of Excel, including PivotTables, lookup functions and reporting. Understanding of inventory management, marketplace fees, returns and seller settlements. Ability to analyse sales data and identify business improvement opportunities. Experience with Tally or other accounting systems is desirable. Good communication, coordination and problem-solving skills. Personal Attributes Detail-oriented and comfortable working with numbers. Takes ownership of tasks and follows through without constant supervision. Able to identify discrepancies and investigate their root causes. Proactive in identifying opportunities to improve sales and profitability. Honest, organised and comfortable reporting problems transparently. Reporting Structure The position will report directly to the business owner or designated business head and coordinate with manufacturing, warehouse, marketing and accounts teams. Expected Deliverables Daily sales and operations report. Weekly SKU-wise sales, inventory and advertising report. Weekly returns, reimbursement and settlement tracker. Monthly SKU-wise profitability and e-commerce P&L report. Monthly action plan to improve sales, control costs and increase profitability. Important: The role is not limited to uploading products and processing orders. The candidate must understand the commercial side of e-commerce and help management make informed decisions based on sales, costs, inventory and profitability.

title: Process Transformation & Technology Specialist - FAPS
description:
Process Transformation & Technology Specialist - Finance and Procurement Business Operations- Transformation 
 Function 
Finance & Procurement Business Operations 
 Scope 
Accounts Payable (AP), Accounts Receivable (AR), Intercompany, Master Data Management, Procurement Operations and Service desk Transformation.

 Position Summary 
Process Transformation & Technology Specialist plays a critical role in driving operational excellence and transformation initiatives across global Finance and Procurement functions. The role is responsible for identifying, designing, and implementing process improvements, automation solutions, and operating model enhancements that improve efficiency, controls, stakeholder experience, and business outcomes.
Working across Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Intercompany, Master Data, and Procurement processes, this position partners closely with Finance and Procurement Operations, Shared Services, Controllership, Business Teams, and Digital Technology organizations to translate strategic priorities into scalable, measurable solutions.

 Key Responsibilities 
 Transformation & Process Excellence 
 Lead and deliver transformation initiatives across AP, AR, Intercompany, Master Data, and Procurement in alignment with the broader Finance Transformation roadmap. Analyze current-state processes, identify root causes and inefficiencies, and design future-state solutions that improve service delivery, controls, compliance, and efficiency. Drive process standardization, simplification, and harmonization across regions while balancing local regulatory and business requirements. Develop business cases, process maps, operating procedures, requirements documentation, test scenarios, and deployment plans. Identify opportunities to improve transaction quality, cycle times, working capital performance, and overall process effectiveness. Support implementation activities including user acceptance testing, defect resolution, cutover planning, and post-go-live stabilization. 
 Digital Transformation & Automation 
 Partner with technology teams and process owners to evaluate, prioritize, and deploy automation and workflow solutions. Leverage process mining, process intelligence, and analytics capabilities to identify improvement opportunities and measure outcomes. Support implementation of digital technologies including SAP Signavio, SAP Build Process Automation, Microsoft Power Platform, AI-enabled tools, and workflow technologies. Drive adoption of analytics and reporting solutions using Power BI, Databricks, and related platforms. Explore and implement practical AI and machine learning use cases to improve knowledge management, decision support, transaction processing, and operational efficiency. Ensure automation solutions incorporate appropriate governance, controls, auditability, data quality standards, and ownership frameworks. 
 Stakeholder Management & Change Leadership 
 Facilitate workshops, process reviews, design sessions, and governance forums with key stakeholders. Build alignment across Finance, Procurement, Shared Services, Technology, and Business teams to support successful transformation outcomes. Develop communication plans, training materials, operating procedures, and change management strategies. Manage risks, dependencies, and escalations while ensuring stakeholder engagement and adoption. Promote a culture of continuous improvement through Lean, Six Sigma, and best-practice methodologies. 
 Governance, Controls & Performance Management 
 Maintain project governance artifacts including project plans, risk registers, issue logs, action trackers, dependency logs, and benefits realization frameworks. Provide regular executive-level reporting on delivery progress, milestones, risks, adoption, and value realization. Ensure solutions remain compliant with finance policies, internal controls, audit requirements, regulatory obligations, and governance standards. Monitor post-implementation performance and drive corrective actions when expected outcomes are not achieved. Contribute to the development of transformation playbooks, methodologies, standards, and reusable assets. 
 Required Qualifications 
 Education 
 Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Commerce, Business Administration, or a related discipline. MBA, Master's degree, PGDBA, or equivalent postgraduate qualification preferred. Lean Six Sigma, PMP, Agile, Change Management, or other transformation certifications preferred. 
 Professional Experience 
 8+ years of experience in Finance Operations, Shared Services, Global Business Services (GBS), Procurement Operations, or Management Consulting. Minimum 3 years of experience leading or supporting finance transformation, process improvement, automation, or operating model initiatives. Demonstrated experience managing cross-functional projects across multiple business units, regions, or stakeholder groups. Strong knowledge of Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Intercompany Accounting, Master Data, and Procurement processes. Experience with SAP ECC and/or SAP S/4HANA environments. Practical experience in process mapping, business requirements definition, operating model design, and implementation support. Experience working with reporting and analytics tools such as Power BI, Excel, Databricks, or equivalent platforms. Automotive, manufacturing, or OEM industry experience strongly preferred. 
 Core Competencies 
 Business Process Expertise 
 Strong understanding of end-to-end AP, AR, Intercompany, Procurement, and Master Data processes. Knowledge of operational KPIs, service levels, controls, compliance requirements, and financial performance drivers. Transformation & Continuous Improvement 
 Proven ability to convert business challenges into scalable process, technology, and operating model solutions. Expertise in process reengineering, root-cause analysis, and continuous improvement methodologies. Data & Analytics 
 Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data, identify trends, and measure business outcomes. Ability to develop insights that drive operational improvements and decision-making. Relationship Management 
 Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence without direct authority. Excellent communication and presentation capabilities across operational and leadership audiences. Governance & Controls 
 Understanding of internal controls, audit frameworks, risk management, segregation of duties, and compliance requirements. Ability to ensure transformation initiatives balance efficiency gains with a strong control environment. 
 Success Measures 
 Success in this role will be measured through: 
 Successful delivery of transformation initiatives within agreed scope, timeline, and budget. Improvements in process efficiency, automation adoption, cycle times, and service quality. Increased straight-through processing and reduction of manual effort, exceptions, and rework. Improvements in working capital metrics including invoice cycle times, DSO, aging, unapplied cash, and intercompany reconciliation performance. Monotype brings brands to life through the type and technology that consumers engage with every day. Monotype also provides a first of-its-kind service that makes fonts more accessible for creative professionals to discover, license, and use in our increasingly digital world. Monotype is looking for a sharp, investigative Data Analyst to help us keep our company and contact data accurate, complete, and reliable. Youll research companies and contacts, verify and enrich records, and judge which sources and data points can be trusted. Youll also take part in workflow automation projects that make data maintenance faster and more consistent. This role is a strong fit for someone who enjoys digging into how companies are structured, notices when something doesnt look right, and wants to understand why a data problem keeps happening, not just fix the record in front of them. What you ll be doing: Identify and resolve duplicates, outdated records, conflicting information, and incorrect account-contact relationships in Salesforce and connected systems. Research and verify company information, including legal names, parent and subsidiary relationships, locations, industries, domains, and firmographic details. Build and maintain accurate account hierarchies that reflect how companies are organized, including mergers, acquisitions, divestitures, rebrands, and regional entities. Use a mix of sources (company websites, public filings, business databases, third-party providers) to confirm and fill in missing information, analyzing and evaluating to identify which is most reliable. Follow and help improve data standards, naming conventions, and research guidelines. Ask clarifying questions to get to the real need behind a request, not just the stated ask. Contribute to automation projects in Syncari, Slack, and AI tools that streamline research, enrichment, matching, and data maintenance. Share hands-on knowledge of data problems to help shape automation requirements and edge cases. Test workflows, review outputs for accuracy, and report issues. What we re looking for: Bachelors degree in Business, Information Systems, Data Analytics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 0-2 years of experience in data research, data operations, sales operations, or a similar role (internships and relevant projects count). Solid understanding of how companies are structured, including parent companies, subsidiaries, legal entities, divisions, brands, and how mergers and acquisitions affect them. Basic understanding of usage of AI tools like ChatGPT. Strong critical thinking skills and good judgment about source credibility and data quality. A sharp eye for patterns, anomalies, and inconsistencies. Ability to investigate a problem, narrow down likely causes, and suggest a sensible solution. High attention to detail and comfort with repetitive work where accuracy matters. What s in it for you: Hybrid work arrangements and competitive paid time off programs. Comprehensive medical insurance coverage to meet all your healthcare needs. Competitive compensation with corporate bonus program & uncapped commission for quota carrying Sales. A creative, innovative, and global working environment in the creative and software technology industry. Highly engaged Events Committee to keep work enjoyable. Reward & Recognition Programs (including Presidents Club for all functions). Professional onboarding program, including robust targeted training for Sales function. Development and advancement opportunities (high internal mobility across organization). Retirement planning options to save for your future, and so much more. description:
Company: SJK Innovations Pvt Ltd. Designation: Assistant Manager Sales & Business Development 
 Position Summary 
 Assistant Manager Sales & Business Development is responsible for leading the Company's sales and business development function, driving revenue growth, expanding market presence, and securing strategic business opportunities within the Aviation sector. The role is accountable for developing and executing business strategies that enhance the Company's competitive position and achieve sustainable growth. 
 The incumbent will lead customer acquisition, strategic account management, tender participation, commercial negotiations, techno commercial and market expansion initiatives while promoting the Company's portfolio, including Passenger Boarding Bridges (PBB), Automated Tray Retrieval System (ATRS) and other aviation-related solutions and services. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Business Development & Market Expansion 
 Develop and execute business development strategies aligned with the Company's growth objectives and annual business plans. Identify, evaluate, and pursue new business opportunities across airports, aviation infrastructure, and related sectors. Build and maintain a robust pipeline of business opportunities to ensure sustainable revenue growth. Monitor market trends, industry developments, competitor activities and upcoming projects to identify potential opportunities. Establish strategic partnerships and business relationships that support long-term growth objectives. Expand the Company's market presence across existing and new geographical territories. 
 Sales & Commercial Management 
 Lead the end-to-end sales process from opportunity identification to contract award. Drive achievement of annual sales, revenue, profitability and market share targets. Prepare and present business proposals, commercial offers, and value-driven solutions to prospective customers. Lead commercial negotiations and contract discussions to secure profitable business. Develop pricing and commercial strategies in coordination with management and relevant stakeholders. Ensure timely follow-up and conversion of opportunities into confirmed business. 
 Customer & Strategic Account Management 
 Build and maintain strong relationships with key customers, airport operators, consultants, airlines, and industry stakeholders. Serve as the primary commercial contact for strategic accounts. Develop account growth plans to maximize customer retention and business expansion opportunities. Ensure high levels of customer satisfaction through proactive engagement and effective relationship management. Identify opportunities for repeat business, contract renewals, and portfolio expansion. 
 Tender & Bid Management 
 Identify and evaluate relevant tender opportunities within the target market segments. Lead the preparation, review, and submission of technical and commercial bids. Coordinate with cross-functional teams to ensure competitive and compliant tender submissions. Participate in bid clarification meetings, commercial discussions, and customer presentations. Improve bid conversion rates through effective opportunity qualification and proposal strategies. 
 Product & Solution Business Development 
 Drive business growth for the Company's product portfolio, including PBB, ATRS and future aviation-related solutions. Identify customer requirements and align product offerings with market demands. Support product positioning, market penetration, and business expansion initiatives. Collaborate with technical teams to develop customer-focused solutions and proposals. 
 Strategic Planning & Performance Management 
 Develop annual sales plans, business forecasts, budgets, and growth strategies. Track business performance against approved targets and key performance indicators. Analyze business trends and recommend initiatives to improve revenue, profitability, and market share. Prepare and present periodic business reviews and management reports. Support the Managing Director in defining and executing long-term business growth strategies. 
 Leadership & Team Development 
 Provide leadership, direction, and guidance to the Sales and Business Development team. Establish clear performance objectives and accountability measures. Develop team capabilities through coaching, mentoring, and structured development initiatives. Foster a performance-driven culture focused on customer success, innovation, and business growth. Promote collaboration and effective coordination across all functional teams. 
 Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) 
 Achievement of sales and revenue targets. Growth in PBB and ATRS business opportunities. New customer acquisition and market expansion. Business pipeline value and conversion ratio. Tender participation and success rate. Customer retention and strategic account growth. Profitability of secured contracts. Accuracy of sales forecasting and business planning. Team performance and capability development.

General Manager Operations & Business Implementations Bengaluru Airport Services Limited (BASL) Job Scop Summary: The General Manager Operations & Business Implementation will be responsible for translating BASLs F&B growth agenda into commercially viable, operationally ready and scalable businesses, leading opportunities from evaluation and implementation through launch, stabilization and expansion 
 The role will translate approved concepts and business plans into operationally ready businesses by leading pre-opening activities, project implementation, manpower planning, training, SOP development, procurement coordination, operational readiness and launch management.
 The incumbent will work closely with the Brand & Product Development, Strategy, Projects, Finance, Procurement, HR, Marketing and Operations teams, as well as external brand partners, consultants and vendors, to ensure that new concepts are launched within agreed timelines, budgets and quality standards. 
 Key Responsibilities: 1. Business Implementation & Launch Management Lead end-to-end implementation of approved F&B brands, concepts and business initiatives. Translate approved business cases and concepts into detailed implementation plans. Develop project timelines, milestones, dependencies and launch plans. Drive projects from concept approval through pre-opening, launch and post-opening stabilization. Ensure timely coordination across all internal and external stakeholders. Identify implementation risks and take timely corrective action. 2. Pre-Opening & Operational Readiness Lead all operational pre-opening activities for new restaurants, cafs, lounges and other F&B formats. Develop comprehensive operational readiness checklists covering manpower, training, SOPs, procurement, technology, equipment, inventory and guest experience. Ensure operational requirements are identified and addressed before launch. Coordinate trials, mock operations, soft openings and readiness assessments. Establish clear go-live criteria and ensure closure of critical gaps before opening. 3. Operations & Process Design Develop and implement operating models for new concepts in line with the approved business plan. Establish SOPs, service standards, workflows and operational controls. Ensure consistency of brand standards and guest experience across locations. Identify opportunities for process improvement, productivity enhancement and cost optimization. Work with Operations teams to ensure smooth transition from project implementation to steady-state operations. 4. Manpower Planning & Capability Building Determine manpower requirements in line with the approved operating model and business volumes. Partner with HR on recruitment, manpower deployment and workforce planning. Develop training and induction plans in coordination with HR and relevant functional teams. Ensure teams are operationally ready before launch. Identify capability gaps and implement appropriate training and development interventions. 5. Procurement, Vendor & Project Coordination Define operational procurement requirements in coordination with Procurement and Projects. Ensure timely availability of equipment, materials, consumables and other operational requirements. Coordinate with vendors, contractors, consultants and brand partners. Monitor project deliverables against agreed specifications, timelines and budgets. Escalate delays, quality issues and critical dependencies to senior leadership. 6. Brand Partner & Stakeholder Management Act as the operational interface with F&B brand partners during implementation. Translate brand standards and technical requirements into executable operating plans. Build strong working relationships with brand owners, franchise partners, consultants and other stakeholders. Ensure alignment between BASL requirements and partner expectations. Resolve implementation-related issues in a timely and commercially appropriate manner. 7. Financial & Commercial Implementation Work with Finance and Business Development teams to ensure implementation is aligned with approved business cases. Monitor implementation expenditure against approved budgets. Identify opportunities for cost optimization without compromising guest experience or brand standards. Support operational ramp-up and achievement of agreed revenue and profitability targets. Provide inputs for financial reviews and post-launch business performance assessments. Provide inputs into business cases, including operational assumptions, manpower, capex/opex requirements, capacity and scalability. Partner with Finance and Business Development to assess unit economics, break-even assumptions and commercial viability. Recommend operational and commercial levers to improve revenue, margins and return on investment. 8. Post-Launch Stabilization Lead the transition from launch to steady-state operations. Leadership & Cross-Functional Collaboration Lead and coordinate cross-functional implementation teams. Establish clear ownership, milestones and accountability for project deliverables. Work closely with Brand & Product Development, Operations, Finance, HR, Procurement, Projects, IT, Marketing and Legal. Provide regular project updates to senior leadership. Build a culture of ownership, execution excellence and accountability. 10. Governance, Risk & Compliance Ensure all new operations comply with applicable statutory, regulatory, food safety, airport and BASL requirements. Ensure appropriate approvals, documentation and controls are in place before launch. Identify and proactively manage operational and implementation risks. Ensure compliance with contractual and brand partner requirements.

Sequence delivery against strategy, capacity and dependencies, giving domain leadership a clear view of what is being delivered and when. Feed the domain portfolio into the enterprise view maintained by the Investment Portfolio Manager, applying central standards so the data is comparable across domains. Consolidate delivery, cost and roadmap information for both domains, working with the domain Tech Finance Manager on the cost picture. Coordinate the domain planning cycle to the enterprise timetable, preparing materials and ensuring leaders have what they need to prioritise. Facilitate domain portfolio governance, with prioritisation decisions taken by domain and platform leadership. Manage cross domain dependencies, resolving what can be resolved locally and escalating what cannot.  Professional Qualifications

Experience running demand management, prioritisation and planning cycles for a domain or business unit. Experience consolidating delivery, cost and roadmap information into a single reliable portfolio view. Experience managing dependencies across teams and escalating what cannot be resolved locally. Experience working to central portfolio standards while operating inside a domain. Familiarity with portfolio tooling, flow metrics and AI enabled analytics applied to forecasting and reporting.

title: Opportunity For RevOps Manager Revenue Operations
description:
Company Description: Beginning as a modest caf in 1953, Paradise Food Court Pvt Ltd. (Paradise Biryani) has grown into one of the most admired restaurant chains in the country. It is an iconic fixture in Hyderabad, recognized for serving the best Biryani and award-winning cuisine loved for its purity and taste. With multiple formats including cafes, bakeries, and restaurants, Paradise ensures top-notch quality and hygiene standards. Recognized by respected media for authentic Hyderabadi cuisine, Paradise is poised for growth, opening new outlets in several cities across India in the coming years. Role Objective: 
 Paradise Biryani is looking for a highly analytical and result-oriented Revenue Operations (RevOps) Manager to drive revenue growth, improve business performance, and identify opportunities across multiple sales channels. The role will focus primarily on dine-in revenue growth , leveraging data analytics, customer insights, pricing strategies, forecasting, and cross-functional collaboration to develop and execute revenue improvement initiatives. The ideal candidate will have strong analytical capabilities, commercial acumen, structured problem-solving skills, and the ability to translate business insights into measurable revenue and profitability improvements. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 1. Revenue Growth & Business Performance Identify and execute opportunities to accelerate dine-in revenue growth across stores. Analyse key revenue drivers, including footfall, customer covers, table turnover, average bill value, repeat visits, and store-level performance. Develop and implement revenue improvement strategies while maintaining healthy profit margins. Own revenue-related business challenges from analysis and solution development through execution and performance measurement. Support revenue optimisation initiatives across delivery, own app, website, and catering channels as required. 
 2. Data Analytics & Business Intelligence Conduct detailed analysis of sales performance, customer behaviour, revenue trends, and operational metrics. Develop and maintain revenue dashboards using BI tools to track business KPIs. Identify revenue gaps, growth opportunities, and performance variations across stores and channels. Convert complex data into actionable business insights and recommendations. Establish regular revenue performance reviews with the Marketing Head and relevant stakeholders. 
 3. Pricing Strategy & Revenue Optimisation Analyse pricing structures across dine-in, delivery, and other sales channels. Develop data-driven pricing models to optimise revenue and profitability. Evaluate menu pricing, promotional offers, discounts, and campaigns based on their revenue and margin impact. Recommend pricing improvements based on customer behaviour, competition, demand, and business performance. Ensure sustainable revenue growth without excessive dependence on discounting. 
 4. Customer Insights & Market Analysis Conduct customer interactions, store visits, surveys, and feedback analysis to understand dining preferences. Identify factors influencing customer acquisition, retention, repeat visits, and dine-in conversion. Translate customer insights into practical revenue growth initiatives. Collaborate with store operations and marketing teams to improve customer experience and business performance. 
 5. Revenue Forecasting & Performance Tracking Develop revenue forecasting models and monitor actual performance against forecasts. Track key business metrics, revenue targets, profitability, and campaign ROI. Conduct variance analysis and recommend corrective actions. Prepare periodic revenue performance reports and business presentations for leadership. 
 6. Cross-Functional Collaboration & Execution Work closely with Marketing, Sales, Finance, Operations, and Technology teams to execute revenue initiatives. Develop hypotheses, conduct pilot programmes, evaluate results, and scale successful initiatives. Coordinate with stakeholders to ensure timely implementation of revenue improvement projects. Drive initiatives from problem identification through execution and measurable business impact. Required Skills & Competencies Advanced Excel: Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, scenario modelling, and large dataset analysis (mandatory). Strong analytical, data interpretation, and structured problem-solving skills. Proficiency in Business Intelligence and dashboarding tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or similar platforms. Understanding of revenue management, business performance metrics, unit economics, and P&L. Strong commercial acumen with knowledge of pricing, profitability, and revenue optimisation. Ability to develop actionable insights from customer and operational data. Strong stakeholder management, communication, and presentation skills. Proven ability to independently execute business improvement initiatives and deliver measurable results. 
 Preferred Skills Experience in revenue forecasting and pricing strategy. Working knowledge of SQL or other data querying tools. Understanding of restaurant/QSR metrics such as customer covers, table turnover, average bill value, and same-store sales growth. Experience conducting business experiments, pilot programmes, or A/B testing. Exposure to marketing campaign ROI, promotional effectiveness, and customer retention analysis. 
 Qualification & Experience Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Economics, Engineering, Statistics, Analytics, or a related field. MBA or relevant postgraduate qualification will be an added advantage. 5 - 8 years of experience in Revenue Operations, Business Analytics, Growth Strategy, Business Operations, Revenue Management, or Management Consulting. title: Senior Manager - HRBP (Night Shift)
description:
Job Description Senior Manager, HR Business Partner (HRBP) 
 Position Senior Manager HR Business Partner Location - Mumbai Department - Human Resources Reports To - HR Sr Director 
 Role Overview We are looking for an experienced Senior Manager HRBP to lead the HR function for our Mumbai location and partner closely with business leaders to drive people strategy, employee engagement, performance, talent development, and organizational effectiveness. The role will serve as a strategic HR partner to the Mumbai leadership team while also ensuring strong execution of HR processes and policies across the location. The ideal candidate will be a hands-on HR leader who can balance business priorities with employee needs, provide strong leadership counsel, and proactively identify and address people-related risks and opportunities. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 1. Business Partnering Partner with business leaders and managers to understand business priorities and translate them into effective people strategies. Act as the primary HR point of contact for the Mumbai location. Provide HR guidance on organizational structure, workforce planning, talent, performance, employee relations, and people-related decisions. Develop a strong understanding of business operations, productivity, workforce requirements, and key business challenges. Participate in leadership discussions and provide data-driven people insights and recommendations. 2. Employee Engagement & Retention Drive employee engagement initiatives across the Mumbai location. Monitor employee sentiment, engagement trends, and key retention risks. Conduct stay interviews and identify actions to retain critical talent. Analyze attrition trends and develop targeted retention plans. Partner with managers to address employee concerns and improve the overall employee experience. 3. Performance Management Drive the annual performance management process across the location. Partner with managers on goal setting, performance reviews, ratings, and performance improvement plans. Ensure consistency and fairness in performance management practices. Coach managers on addressing performance concerns effectively and fairly. Identify high performers and critical talent and support appropriate development and retention actions. 4. Talent Management & Career Development Partner with business leaders to identify critical roles and talent gaps. Drive succession planning and talent reviews. Support internal mobility and IJP programs. Identify career growth opportunities for employees and work with managers to create development plans. Partner with L&D on leadership and capability-building initiatives. 5. Employee Relations Manage and resolve employee relations matters in a fair, consistent, and timely manner. Handle grievances, disciplinary matters, investigations, and workplace concerns in partnership with HR leadership and Legal, where required. Ensure appropriate documentation and adherence to company policies and applicable employment regulations. Support managers in handling sensitive employee situations. 6. Workforce Planning & Organization Effectiveness Partner with business leaders on workforce planning and resource requirements. Support organizational restructuring, role changes, transfers, promotions, and other organizational initiatives. Monitor workforce metrics including headcount, attrition, absenteeism, productivity, and internal movement. Identify organizational gaps and recommend people solutions. 7. HR Analytics & Reporting Develop and present regular HR dashboards and business insights to leadership. Track key people metrics including: Attrition Headcount Employee engagement Absenteeism Internal movement Performance Hiring and workforce trends 8. HR Policy & Compliance Ensure effective implementation of HR policies and processes across the Mumbai location. Partner with HR Compliance and Legal teams to ensure adherence to applicable employment requirements. Identify policy/process gaps and recommend improvements. Ensure managers understand and consistently apply HR policies. 9. Leadership & Team Management Lead and mentor the HR team supporting the Mumbai location. Establish clear priorities and accountability within the HR team. Build strong relationships with business and functional leaders. Drive a proactive and business-focused HR culture. Coach HR team members and support their professional development. 10. Change Management Support business transformation, organizational changes, new process implementations, and other strategic initiatives. Develop effective employee communication and change-management plans. Help leaders manage change while maintaining employee engagement and business continuity. Key Deliverables Effective HR partnership with Mumbai business leadership. Improved employee engagement and retention. Proactive management of attrition and critical talent risks. Consistent and effective performance management. Strong employee relations and timely resolution of workplace concerns. Effective succession planning and internal mobility. Accurate and actionable HR analytics. Strong HR policy implementation and compliance. Development of a high-performing HR team. 
 Education & Experience 
 Bachelors degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field. MBA/PGDM in HR preferred. 1518 years of progressive HR experience, with significant experience in a senior HRBP/HR leadership role. Proven experience partnering with senior business leaders and managing HR for a large location/business unit. Strong experience in employee relations, talent management, performance management, workforce planning, engagement, and organizational effectiveness. Experience managing and developing an HR team. Experience in BPO/ITES/operations environments preferred. Strong exposure to managing HR for a multi-layered workforce, including frontline employees, managers, and senior leadership. 
 Key Skills 
 Strong HR Business Partnering capability. Excellent stakeholder and relationship management. Strong employee relations and conflict-resolution skills. Performance and talent management. Workforce planning and HR analytics. Strong business acumen. Change management and organizational effectiveness. Excellent communication and influencing skills. Strong decision-making and problem-solving ability. Ability to manage sensitive and confidential matters. Strong leadership and people-management skills.

description:
Job Description SUMMARY: The Associate Manager, Player Services, serves as the operational owner of Tier 2 service delivery within the CRC Pune Service Delivery Centre. Reporting into the Director, this role ensures that all service management practices, processes, and performance standards adhere to ITIL 4 principles and organizational goals. The Associate Manager oversees back-office operations, service portfolio performance, and end-to-end player support delivery, ensuring effective alignment with the tiered support functions. Acting as the primary interface between operations, analytics, quality, training, and service governance teams, this role drives continuous improvement, SLA adherence, and service excellence. ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES: Core duties and responsibilities include the following. (Other duties may be assigned.) Team Leadership: Manage and mentor a team of Tier 2 Team Leads, providing guidance, training, and performance evaluations. Back Office Operations: Oversee the daily operations of the back office, ensuring timely and accurate processing of support requests and administrative tasks. Service Portfolio Management: Manage the service portfolio to ensure alignment with organizational goals and effective delivery of services. SLA Management: Ensure adherence to Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and monitor performance to meet or exceed targets. Service Management: Ensure the efficient resolution of player issues, maintaining high levels of player satisfaction. Collaboration: Work closely across all internal external support teams, as well as other departments such as product development and finance, to ensure seamless service delivery. PMO Integration: Collaborate with the Project Management Office (PMO) to ensure alignment of projects and initiatives with service delivery goals. Quality Assurance: Work closely with the quality assurance team to maintain high standards of service delivery. Learning Development: Collaborate with the global Learning Development (LD) team to ensure continuous training and development of the support team. Reporting: Prepare and present regular reports on team performance, operational efficiency, and service metrics to senior management. Escalation Management: Handle escalated player issues and ensure they are resolved promptly and satisfactorily. Compliance: Ensure all support activities comply with company policies, local policies, industry standards, and regulatory requirements. Global Practices: Ensure robust adherence to global practices and standards, aligning with the organizations international policies and procedures. Local Leadership: Act as the local leader, representing the CRC service delivery centre, fostering a positive work environment, and addressing local challenges and opportunities. Collaboration with Local Leadership: Work closely with local leadership to align the service delivery centres goals with regional objectives, ensuring cohesive and effective operations. ITIL Integration: Implement ITIL methodology and best practices to enhance service delivery and operational efficiency. Performance Management: Define and execute operational strategies by conducting needs assessments, performance reviews, by utilizing the MAP system effectively. Performance Tracking: Utilize relevant data, daily reports, performance observation, and all established KPI s to track and evaluate individual and team performance. Human Resources: Actively and regularly engage with your local Human Resource Business Partners and your senior leadership regarding team morale, performance risks, and all personnel issues which may impact business operations. Qualifications QUALIFICATIONS: To perform this job successfully, you must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. You must be able to take a hands-on approach while maintaining self-sufficiency when working independently. Excellent communication, collaboration, and organizational skills with attention to detail while providing innovative thinking and continuous process improvement will define your success in this role. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. EDUCATION: Bachelors degree in Business Administration, Information Technology, or a related field EXPERIENCE: Minimum 3 years of experience in a player support or service role, with at least 2 years in a managerial position. SKILLS: Strong leadership and team management skills. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. Ability to analyze data and generate actionable insights. Proficiency in player support software and tools. Strong problem-solving and decision-making abilities. Knowledge of ITIL practices and methodologies. PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS: Experience in a global organization. ITIL certification. Multilingual capabilities. WORKING CONDITIONS: This role may require occasional travel. Ability to work flexible hours to accommodate global time zones.

 Marsh is seeking a Vendor Risk Management expert for the following position based in the Pune, India office. Designation: Senior Manager - Operations Management (GS - Vendor Ops Third Party Vendor Risk Management ) Location: Pune, India 
 
 Responsibilities 
 Strategic Leadership: Develop and refine the third-party risk management strategy aligned with organizational goals and regulatory requirements. Risk Assessment Due Diligence: Manage comprehensive risk assessments for high-risk vendors, including financial stability, cybersecurity, operational resilience, privacy/AI, compliance, and reputational risks. Policy Framework Development: Establish, implement, and continuously improve policies, procedures, and standards for third-party risk management. Vendor Lifecycle Management: Oversee the entire vendor lifecycle, from onboarding and due diligence to ongoing monitoring and offboarding. Risk Monitoring Reporting: Design and oversee the implementation of key risk indicators (KRIs), dashboards, and reporting mechanisms for senior management and risk committees. Regulatory Industry Compliance: Ensure all third-party activities comply with applicable laws, regulations, and industry standards (e.g., GDPR, HIPAA, DORA, SOC, etc.). Stakeholder Collaboration: Partner with legal, procurement, compliance, IT, and other risk management functions to evaluate vendor risks and develop mitigation strategies. Third-Party Risk Program Oversight: Lead the third-party risk management team, providing mentorship, guidance, and performance management. Issue Incident Management: Oversee the investigation and resolution of third-party risk incidents, including breach or compliance issues. Audit Review: Coordinate internal and external audits related to third-party risk, ensuring timely remediation of identified issues. Training Awareness: Promote a risk-aware culture through training programs, workshops, and communication initiatives. External Relationships: Manage relationships with external vendors, risk assessment providers, and industry forums. 
 
 What you need to have 
 Bachelor's degree with 8-10 years of experience. Masters preferred > 5 years of experience in third-party/vendor risk management, compliance, or related fields Deep understanding of regulatory frameworks, industry standards, and best practices related to third-party risk. Proven experience managing complex vendor portfolios, including high-risk or strategic vendors. Strong knowledge of cybersecurity, data privacy, operational resilience, and contractual risk mitigation. Demonstrated ability to develop and implement risk management frameworks and policies. Excellent leadership, strategic thinking, and stakeholder management skills. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making capabilities. Professional certifications such as Certified Third Party Risk Professional (CTPRP), Certified Risk Management Professional (CRMP), Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP), or equivalent are highly desirable. 
 
 What makes you stand out 
 Experience in highly regulated industries such as financial services, Insurance, or technology. Familiarity with third-party risk management tools and platforms. Understanding of Procurement functions such as Sourcing, Contracting, Vendor Operations and Buyer functions. Ability to influence organizational culture and promote risk awareness. Strong communication skills, capable of presenting complex risk issues to executive leadership. 
 
 Why join our team 
 We help you be your best through professional development opportunities, interesting work and supportive leaders. We foster a vibrant and inclusive culture where you can work with talented colleagues to create new solutions and have impact for colleagues, clients and communities. Our scale enables us to provide a range of career opportunities, as well as benefits and rewards to enhance your well-being.

title: Operations and Support Engineer
description:
Role overview The Operations Support Engineer keeps DigiXPro digital exams running smoothly on the ground at universities and colleges. You will set up and manage exam tablets, keep the exam network stable, run exams as per our SOP, and resolve issues for students, invigilators and exam staff in real time. DigiXPro is a tab-based digital examination and AI-assisted evaluation platform by Restech Edugauge Private Limited, used by higher-education institutions across India. Key responsibilities 1. Device and tablet management Set up, configure and maintain exam tablets (Android tablets and iPads), styluses and chargers Install and update the DigiXPro exam app, OS updates and security settings; Check battery health, charging, screen and stylus condition before every exam Raise OEM warranty/repair claims for faulty devices Keep devices clean, charged and ready as per the device care checklist 2. Device movement and logistics Plan and manage movement of tablets between warehouse, campuses and exam halls Pack, label and seal devices for safe transport; maintain dispatch and receipt records Ensure delivery to exam venues on time and collect all devices after the exam Report any loss, damage or shortfall immediately 3. Inventory management Maintain an accurate inventory of all devices and accessories by serial number, location and status Track devices issued to and returned from each campus and exam session Do regular stock audits and reconcile counts after every exam cycle Flag devices due for repair, replacement or retirement 4. Network and infrastructure support Set up and test exam-hall LAN, Wi-Fi access points and network switches before exams Troubleshoot connectivity issues across devices, local servers and cloud (AWS) services Monitor network load during exams and fix bandwidth or access-point issues quickly Work with the college IT team on firewall, whitelisting and server access 5. L1 support during exams Resolve student and invigilator issues on the spot: login failures, app crashes, device freezes, stylus or display problems Handle answer submission and sync issues; ensure no student response is lost Swap faulty devices with standby units and restore the student's session Escalate unresolved issues to L2/engineering within defined timelines 6. Own escalations and ensure efficient and timely resolutions. Track, manage, and prioritize work items through JIRA (or equivalent), ensuring adherence to defined SLAs. title: Operations Manager
description:
Job Title: Operations Manager US Staffing Job Summary We are looking for an experienced and result-oriented Operations Manager – US Staffing to oversee daily staffing operations, manage recruitment and delivery teams, improve operational efficiency, and ensure timely fulfillment of client requirements. The candidate will be responsible for managing end-to-end US staffing operations, monitoring team performance, implementing recruitment strategies, and ensuring that business objectives and client expectations are met. The ideal candidate should have strong knowledge of US IT staffing, recruitment delivery, vendor management, team leadership, and operational reporting. Roles and Responsibilities Manage and oversee day-to-day operations of the US IT staffing and recruitment team. Lead, mentor, and manage US IT recruiters, team leads, delivery managers, and other operational staff. Monitor recruitment activities, including sourcing, screening, candidate submissions, interview coordination, and placements. Ensure timely fulfillment of client requirements and maintain high-quality candidate submissions. Develop and implement operational strategies to improve recruiter productivity, delivery efficiency, and placement ratios. Monitor daily, weekly, and monthly performance metrics, including submissions, interviews, closures, and revenue generation. Establish and track key performance indicators (KPIs) for recruitment teams and individual recruiters. Coordinate with Business Development Managers (BDMs), account managers, and client-facing teams to understand hiring requirements and business priorities. Manage recruitment delivery for Tier-1 vendors, prime vendors, direct clients, and staffing partners. Ensure effective communication and coordination between recruitment, sales, account management, and compliance teams. Monitor the complete recruitment lifecycle, from requirement allocation and candidate sourcing to offer acceptance and onboarding. Identify operational bottlenecks and implement corrective measures to improve turnaround time and recruitment outcomes. Develop standard operating procedures (SOPs), workflow guidelines, and reporting mechanisms to ensure consistent operations. Manage recruiter allocation, workload distribution, and resource planning based on client requirements and business priorities. Review team performance regularly, provide coaching and feedback, and implement performance improvement plans when required. Ensure accurate maintenance of candidate databases, ATS records, submission trackers, and operational reports. Oversee coordination for vendor onboarding, candidate documentation, background verification, and compliance requirements, as applicable. Manage escalations related to candidate dropouts, interview delays, submission quality, and client delivery concerns. Analyze recruitment and operational data to identify trends, improve productivity, and support management decisions. Work closely with senior management to develop operational plans, improve profitability, and achieve organizational goals. Ensure recruitment processes follow company policies, contractual obligations, and applicable employment and data privacy requirements. Required Skills and Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Human Resources, or a related field. Proven experience in US IT staffing operations, recruitment delivery, or staffing team management. Strong understanding of the US staffing recruitment lifecycle and vendor ecosystem. Experience managing recruiters, team leads, and recruitment delivery teams. Knowledge of Tier-1 vendors, prime vendors, direct clients, and US staffing engagement models. Strong leadership, team management, problem-solving, and decision-making skills. Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and escalation-handling abilities. Experience tracking recruitment KPIs, preparing MIS reports, and analyzing operational performance. Familiarity with Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS), CRM platforms, Excel, and recruitment reporting tools. Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, target-driven environment. Strong focus on operational efficiency, recruitment quality, client satisfaction, and business results. Preferred Experience 5–10 years of experience in US IT staffing, recruitment operations, or staffing delivery management. Prior experience managing a team of US IT recruiters and team leads. Experience handling multiple clients, vendor requirements, and high-volume recruitment operations. Knowledge of C2C, W2, and other applicable US staffing engagement models. Experience in process improvement, performance management, and operational planning. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Overall recruitment team productivity. Number of candidate submissions, interviews, and successful placements. Requirement fulfillment rate and time-to-fill. Submission-to-interview and interview-to-placement conversion rates. Revenue generation and delivery profitability, where applicable. Recruiter productivity and target achievement. Candidate retention, joining ratios, and offer-to-joining conversion. Client satisfaction and resolution of escalations. Operational efficiency and adherence to defined processes. Accuracy and timeliness of MIS and operational reports. title: Process Transformation & Technology Specialist - FAPS
description:
Process Transformation & Technology Specialist - Finance and Procurement Business Operations- Transformation 
 Function 
Finance & Procurement Business Operations 
 Scope 
Accounts Payable (AP), Accounts Receivable (AR), Intercompany, Master Data Management, Procurement Operations and Service desk Transformation.

 Position Summary 
Process Transformation & Technology Specialist plays a critical role in driving operational excellence and transformation initiatives across global Finance and Procurement functions. The role is responsible for identifying, designing, and implementing process improvements, automation solutions, and operating model enhancements that improve efficiency, controls, stakeholder experience, and business outcomes.
Working across Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Intercompany, Master Data, and Procurement processes, this position partners closely with Finance and Procurement Operations, Shared Services, Controllership, Business Teams, and Digital Technology organizations to translate strategic priorities into scalable, measurable solutions.

 Key Responsibilities 
 Transformation & Process Excellence 
 Lead and deliver transformation initiatives across AP, AR, Intercompany, Master Data, and Procurement in alignment with the broader Finance Transformation roadmap. Analyze current-state processes, identify root causes and inefficiencies, and design future-state solutions that improve service delivery, controls, compliance, and efficiency. Drive process standardization, simplification, and harmonization across regions while balancing local regulatory and business requirements. Develop business cases, process maps, operating procedures, requirements documentation, test scenarios, and deployment plans. Identify opportunities to improve transaction quality, cycle times, working capital performance, and overall process effectiveness. Support implementation activities including user acceptance testing, defect resolution, cutover planning, and post-go-live stabilization. 
 Digital Transformation & Automation 
 Partner with technology teams and process owners to evaluate, prioritize, and deploy automation and workflow solutions. Leverage process mining, process intelligence, and analytics capabilities to identify improvement opportunities and measure outcomes. Support implementation of digital technologies including SAP Signavio, SAP Build Process Automation, Microsoft Power Platform, AI-enabled tools, and workflow technologies. Drive adoption of analytics and reporting solutions using Power BI, Databricks, and related platforms. Explore and implement practical AI and machine learning use cases to improve knowledge management, decision support, transaction processing, and operational efficiency. Ensure automation solutions incorporate appropriate governance, controls, auditability, data quality standards, and ownership frameworks. 
 Stakeholder Management & Change Leadership 
 Facilitate workshops, process reviews, design sessions, and governance forums with key stakeholders. Build alignment across Finance, Procurement, Shared Services, Technology, and Business teams to support successful transformation outcomes. Develop communication plans, training materials, operating procedures, and change management strategies. Manage risks, dependencies, and escalations while ensuring stakeholder engagement and adoption. Promote a culture of continuous improvement through Lean, Six Sigma, and best-practice methodologies. 
 Governance, Controls & Performance Management 
 Maintain project governance artifacts including project plans, risk registers, issue logs, action trackers, dependency logs, and benefits realization frameworks. Provide regular executive-level reporting on delivery progress, milestones, risks, adoption, and value realization. Ensure solutions remain compliant with finance policies, internal controls, audit requirements, regulatory obligations, and governance standards. Monitor post-implementation performance and drive corrective actions when expected outcomes are not achieved. Contribute to the development of transformation playbooks, methodologies, standards, and reusable assets. 
 Required Qualifications 
 Education 
 Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Commerce, Business Administration, or a related discipline. MBA, Master's degree, PGDBA, or equivalent postgraduate qualification preferred. Lean Six Sigma, PMP, Agile, Change Management, or other transformation certifications preferred. 
 Professional Experience 
 8+ years of experience in Finance Operations, Shared Services, Global Business Services (GBS), Procurement Operations, or Management Consulting. Minimum 3 years of experience leading or supporting finance transformation, process improvement, automation, or operating model initiatives. Demonstrated experience managing cross-functional projects across multiple business units, regions, or stakeholder groups. Strong knowledge of Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Intercompany Accounting, Master Data, and Procurement processes. Experience with SAP ECC and/or SAP S/4HANA environments. Practical experience in process mapping, business requirements definition, operating model design, and implementation support. Experience working with reporting and analytics tools such as Power BI, Excel, Databricks, or equivalent platforms. Automotive, manufacturing, or OEM industry experience strongly preferred. 
 Core Competencies 
 Business Process Expertise 
 Strong understanding of end-to-end AP, AR, Intercompany, Procurement, and Master Data processes. Knowledge of operational KPIs, service levels, controls, compliance requirements, and financial performance drivers. Transformation & Continuous Improvement 
 Proven ability to convert business challenges into scalable process, technology, and operating model solutions. Expertise in process reengineering, root-cause analysis, and continuous improvement methodologies. Data & Analytics 
 Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data, identify trends, and measure business outcomes. Ability to develop insights that drive operational improvements and decision-making. Relationship Management 
 Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence without direct authority. Excellent communication and presentation capabilities across operational and leadership audiences. Governance & Controls 
 Understanding of internal controls, audit frameworks, risk management, segregation of duties, and compliance requirements. Ability to ensure transformation initiatives balance efficiency gains with a strong control environment. 
 Success Measures 
 Success in this role will be measured through: 
 Successful delivery of transformation initiatives within agreed scope, timeline, and budget. Improvements in process efficiency, automation adoption, cycle times, and service quality. Increased straight-through processing and reduction of manual effort, exceptions, and rework. Improvements in working capital metrics including invoice cycle times, DSO, aging, unapplied cash, and intercompany reconciliation performance. Improved master data quality, governance adherence, and turnaround times. Sustainable governance, controls compliance, and audit readiness. 
 Preferred Technology Landscape 
 SAP S/4HANA and SAP ECC SAP Signavio (Process Mining, Process Insights, Process Modeling) SAP Build Process Automation (SAP BTP) SAP MDG and SAP GRC SAP Joule / SAP Business AI Microsoft Power Platform (Power BI, Power Apps, Power Automate) Microsoft Copilot and Copilot Studio Databricks KNIME Analytics Platform OpenText Workflow Solutions Intercompany Accounting Systems (IAS) SharePoint and Enterprise Collaboration Platforms

Job Description Job Title: Senior Manager, Applied Science - Instamart Team: Data Science Years of Exp: 8 - 12
Location: Bangalore, India About the Team The Role The Swiggy Data Science team is a vibrant group of scientists, engineers, and problem-solvers who are passionate about tackling some of the most complex challenges in machine learning at scale. We work on everything from ETA prediction and delivery partner assignment to personalized recommendations, demand forecasting, and fraud detection. We are looking for an experienced and visionary Data Science Senior Manager to lead a team of talented data scientists. In this role, you will be a player-coach, blending deep technical expertise with strategic thinking and people leadership. You will own the roadmap for a critical business area, partner with product and engineering leaders, and guide your team to build and deploy ML models that drive direct business impact. This isnt just a management role; its an opportunity to shape the future of convenience in India. What Youll Do: Lead Mentor: Lead, manage, and mentor a team of 8-10 data scientists and machine learning engineers, fostering their career growth and building a culture of innovation, accountability, and excellence. Strategic Roadmap Vision: Partner with Product, Engineering, and Business leaders to identify high-impact opportunities. You will translate ambiguous business problems into a clear, data-driven strategic roadmap for your team. Technical Leadership Execution: Oversee the end-to-end machine learning lifecycle-from ideation, data exploration, and model prototyping to deployment, monitoring, and iteration. You will ensure the team adheres to the highest standards of statistical rigor and engineering best practices. Problem Solving on latest Generative AI solutions: Guide your team in solving complex problems in personalization support discovery and internal productivity: Logistics Fulfillment: Optimizing the three-way marketplace (ETA prediction, batching, driver assignment, route optimization). Discovery Personalization: Building recommendation engines, personalized search, and discovery journeys for Food, Instamart, and Dineout. Growth Economics: Customer segmentation, LTV prediction, churn modeling, and designing optimal pricing and promotion strategies. Forecasting Supply Chain: Demand forecasting for Instamart, restaurant supply prediction, and inventory management. Stakeholder Management Communication: Effectively communicate complex technical concepts and the business impact of your teams work to a diverse audience, including senior leadership. Hiring Team Building: Be a bar-raiser for talent. Actively participate in the hiring process to attract and retain top-tier data scientists. What Youll Need (Must-Have Skills): Educational Background: A Bachelor s or Master s in a quantitative field like Computer Science, Statistics, Operations Research, Economics, or a related discipline. Experience: 10+ years of hands-on experience in Data Science, Applied Science or a Machine Learning-focused role. 2+ years of experience in a formal leadership capacity, managing and mentoring data scientists. Technical Proficiency: Expert-level proficiency in Python and its data science libraries (e.g., Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn, Matplotlib). Deep, hands-on experience with modern machine learning frameworks like TensorFlow, PyTorch, or Keras. Strong expertise in SQL and experience with large-scale data processing using tools like Spark, Hive, or Presto. A solid understanding of both classical ML and deep learning along with exposure to Generative AI solutions (e.g., CNNs, RNNs, Transformers). Core Competencies: Problem Formulation: A proven track record of converting vague business questions into well-defined machine learning problems. Statistical Rigor: Deep understanding of statistical methods, experimental design (A/B testing), and causal inference. ML Systems Design: Experience in deploying, monitoring, and maintaining machine learning models in production environments. Familiarity with MLOps principles and tools (e.g., Kubeflow, MLflow) is a strong plus. Leadership: Exceptional leadership skills with a passion for developing people and building high-performing teams. Communication: Outstanding communication and presentation skills, with the ability to influence and align cross-functional partners. Why Join Swiggy Unprecedented Scale: Work with one of the richest datasets in India, covering user behavior, logistics, geography, and real-time transactions. Tangible Impact: See your models come to life and directly influence the experience of millions of Indians in near real-time. The feedback loop is immediate and gratifying. Complex Challenges: The problems we are solving are not just intellectually stimulating; they are unique to our three-way marketplace and will push the boundaries of your knowledge. A Culture of Data: We are a data-driven organization from top to bottom. Your work will be valued, and your insights will shape our strategy. World-Class Team: Collaborate with a brilliant, diverse, and humble team of data scientists, engineers, and product managers who are among the best in the industry Qualifications Preferred Qualifications: Experience working with real-time, low-latency model deployment and MLOps. Strong experience with geospatial data and relevant libraries (e.g., GeoPandas, H3, S2). A portfolio of patents or publications in top-tier ML/AI conferences (e.g., NeurIPS, ICML, KDD, ICLR). Prior experience leading and scaling a team of scientists.

title: Logistics Executive
description:
Role & responsibilities : 
 Pre-Arrival Planning & ETA Tracking: Track vessel ETAs and receive Arrival Notices from carriers/freight forwarders, checking them against Bills of Lading and booking details to flag mismatches early and secure port free time. Customs & Duty Clearance Management: Work alongside US customs brokers to submit timely entriesincluding ISF (10+2), Customs Entry (CBP Form 7501), and partner-agency filings—while confirming HTS classifications, arranging duty payments, and resolving customs holds. Document Verification & Shipment Release: Ensure complete documentation (Bill of Lading, Commercial Invoice, Packing List, Certificate of Origin, SDS) is in place prior to pickup to secure carrier releases, freight releases, and terminal availability. Drayage & Transport Booking: Solicit and compare quotes from a pool of truckers to arrange drayage and over-the-road (FTL/LTL) transport from US ports directly to domestic warehouses or customer sites. Appointment Scheduling & Equipment Planning: Coordinate pickup appointments at port terminals, delivery appointments at warehouses/customer sites, and manage chassis requirements, empty container returns, or trans loading as needed. Proactive Tracking & Demurrage Prevention: Track every shipment daily from arrival to proof of delivery (POD), updating internal teams and customers while acting early to prevent demurrage, detention, per diem, and storage fees. Vendor Management & Cost Reporting: Audit and approve freight, brokerage, and trucking invoices against contracted rates, manage vendor relationships, and maintain weekly tracking reports covering clearance times, costs, and open issues.

title: Customer Support Representative II
description:
Job Description This is role is for Gracenote - A Global entertainment data and technology company that provides music, video, and sports metadata, automatic content recognition (ACR), and content discovery solutions that power search and recommendations for leading streaming platforms, broadcasters, and automakers worldwide. Gracenote is the content data business unit of Nielsen that powers innovative entertainment experiences for the world s leading media companies. Our entertainment metadata and connected IDs deliver advanced content navigation and discovery to connect consumers to the content they love and discover new ones. We are currently seeking a dedicated Customer Support Specialist to deliver exceptional day-to-day assistance to both our new and established clients. In this position, you will collaborate closely with internal cross-functional technical teams as well as our external clients engineering and business departments. Your primary objective will be to efficiently troubleshoot and resolve reported problems, adhering strictly to our service level agreement (SLA) timeframes. Responsibilities : Provide first-level customer support for assigned customers, primarily through the Gracenote CRM / ticketing system. Responsible for setting deadlines and coordinating the completion of standard change requests and Discrepancy resolution for customer-submitted tickets, within SLA guidelines. Respond, evaluate, troubleshoot and prioritize incoming product-related issues and effectively escalate to various technical support staff when needed. Coordinate with multiple internal departments to resolve customer-related issues or requests. Entitle customers to newly licensed products. Provide customers with timely, clear, and concise status and information related to sales requests, change requests and Discrepancies including resolution, access, and other key details. Evaluate incoming product-related issues and escalate to account manager when needed. Adhere to and reinforce the practice of documenting all customer activity in the Gracenote CRM (currently Zendesk). Develop a strong understanding of the business to relate problems to business impacts. Understand when to place a sense of urgency and when to escalate critical problems. Provision access to standard samples to customers during the pre-sales process. Maintain an accurate customer contact list, and customer delivery profiles, including API keys and FTP server logins.Monitor and modify customer delivery profiles as required. Issue billing for all change requests requiring billing adjustments. Disable product access and keep CRM records current for customer cancellations Provide on-call support ( Rotational coverage required 24/7) for customers escalating urgent issues or requests. Participate in customer calls as required. Notify the Customer Success Manager and your manager of customer escalations related to service or quality Qualifications Associates or Bachelor s degree in a technical discipline or 1 - 3 years experience in a customer facing role. Must possess strong customer service skills, emotional intelligence and excellent interpersonal and communication skills, both verbal and written. Must be able to work the shift hours identified as well as adjust the shift as required by the business. Flexibility to extend the support to the team in their working hours if required. Experience in research and resolution of problems using analytical skills in a digital environment is strongly preferred. Working knowledge of business software/applications - Google Suite, Jira, Salesforce, a plus. Must be self-motivated and able to work effectively with minimum supervision and assume responsibility for appropriate follow-through. Ability to adapt to a fast-changing work environment while maintaining stability of performance under pressure and to demonstrate patience and control when dealing with difficult situations. For this role we are looking for Individuals who have: Agents should be available to work during the daytime hours required to support customers in their respective regions. Additionally, flexibility is required to provide ad-hoc support for alternative working hours, and weekends as needed. Ability to participate in the after hours coverage to address urgent after business hours on call rotation (US weekend evening hours) on a rotating basis required. Ability to handle customer inquiries and complaints professionally. Excellent English language verbal and written communication skills Strong customer service skills, emotional intelligence and excellent interpersonal and communication skills. Self-motivated and able to work effectively with minimum supervision and assume responsibility for appropriate follow-through. Proficiency in using CRM systems (specifically Zendesk) Basic knowledge of product licensing and entitlements, a plus Familiarity with ticketing systems and SLA guidelines Ability to set and manage deadlines. Analytical thinking to evaluate and troubleshoot issues Basic troubleshooting skills. Ability to adapt to changing customer needs and priorities Strong documentation skills. Ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities simultaneously. Working knowledge of business software/applications - Google Suite, Microsoft Office Suite.

The incumbent will be responsible for handling customer queries, complaints, requests and service-related interactions while ensuring a high level of customer satisfaction.
The role requires a highly customer-focused individual with excellent communication skills, a positive attitude and the ability to coordinate effectively with internal teams to drive timely resolution of customer concerns.
The ideal candidate should be comfortable handling multiple customer interactions, understanding customer requirements, identifying appropriate solutions and maintaining a professional and empathetic approach throughout the interaction. Designation: Executive Role: Customer Care
