title: Product Designer
description:
Role & responsibilities 
 1. Research & Concept Development Interpret client briefs, product requirements, target users, market needs, and project objectives. Conduct product and competitor research, trend analysis, and design benchmarking. Lead brainstorming and ideation; explore alternatives through hand sketches, mood boards, form studies, and concept narratives. Evaluate concepts for aesthetics, usability, functionality, and feasibility, then recommend a clear design direction. 2. Industrial Design & Visualization Develop product form, proportions, ergonomics, and CMF (color, material, and finish). Create 2D sketches, 3D models, and high-quality renders to communicate concepts and support client presentations. Build clear visual presentations that explain the design rationale, key features, and intended user experience. Refine concepts based on feedback while maintaining design intent and visual quality. 3. Client Communication & Collaboration Clarify client expectations, functional requirements, preferences, and constraints; translate them into actionable design briefs. Present concepts and explain design decisions, gather feedback, and manage design iterations with clear communication. Work with R&D, engineering, sourcing, and production teams to align the design with project requirements. 4. Prototype Development & Validation Create mock-ups, low-fidelity prototypes, and digital or physical models to explore and validate concepts. Collaborate with engineering teams to develop functional prototypes and communicate design intent during handover. Review prototypes for aesthetics, ergonomics, proportions, and usability; identify gaps and recommend improvements. 5. Product Graphics & Packaging Design product-related graphics, labels, icons, product markings, packaging artwork, and instruction-manual layouts as required. Create product feature graphics, infographics, and visual guides that support product communication. Prepare print-ready artwork and coordinate with relevant teams or suppliers for implementation. 6. Design Delivery & Workflow Maintain organized design files, presentations, renderings, and revision records. Research relevant materials, finishes, technologies, and design methods to inform design decisions. Use AI-assisted tools where helpful for ideation, visualization, and workflow efficiency. Manage assigned tasks and timelines while maintaining quality and consistency. Preferred candidate profile 
 Bachelor of Design (B.Des.) in Product Design, Industrial Design, or a closely related design discipline. At least 2 years of relevant experience in product or industrial design. Strong hand-sketching, ideation, form development, and concept-presentation skills. Experience with 3D modeling and product visualization; ability to produce high-quality renders. Working knowledge of Adobe Illustrator and Photoshop for product graphics and artwork. Understanding of materials, manufacturing methods, ergonomics, CMF, and prototype development. Strong communication, problem-solving, and collaboration skills. Preferred Qualifications Experience with consumer products, beauty and wellness devices, electronics, or similar physical products. Familiarity with SolidWorks, Fusion 360,  or equivalent 3D modeling tools. Experience with KeyShot or similar rendering software. Exposure to rapid prototyping, mock-up development, and design validation. Core Skills Creative problem-solving • Hand sketching and ideation • Industrial design and form exploration • 3D modeling and photorealistic rendering • Client communication • Prototype development • Graphic design and packaging artwork • CMF and ergonomics • Cross-functional collaboration • Project and time management

title: E learning developer - Contract Role
description:
Position: E learning developer /Graphics Designer Senior Associate 
 Experience: 4 8 years of relevant experience The Opportunity This position will support the design and development of engaging visual content for eLearning modules and other digital learning materials. The Graphics Designer will work to agreed design quality standards and processes, using approved templates and tools, and will collaborate with other designers and learning professionals to enhance the quality and effectiveness of visual learning solutions. Additionally, the designer will develop and maintain strong relationships with content owners, Subject Matter Reviewers (SMRs), and other stakeholders. Your Key Responsibilities Proficiently create and customize eLearning modules using development tools, implementing interactive elements and assessments. Independently produce high-quality graphic designs and layouts, mentoring junior designers in the process. Manage LMS content areas, troubleshooting issues and providing user support while mentoring others in LMS usage. Design and implement interactive elements for eLearning modules, creating complex interactive experiences. Produce animations and videos, including storyboarding, editing, and post-production, contributing to creative brainstorming sessions. Create a wide range of visual assets, including complex graphics and illustrations, guiding junior designers in asset production. Design sophisticated typographic and layout solutions, setting benchmarks for quality and brand compliance. Ensure all designs meet accessibility standards, advocating for inclusive design practices and mentoring others in best practices. Design and implement gamification strategies within eLearning modules to enhance engagement and learning retention. Craft compelling visual narratives that align with project messages and goals, developing storyboards and providing creative direction. Apply design principles to enhance project outcomes, mentoring junior designers in effective design practices. Communicate design ideas clearly, gathering feedback effectively and engaging in collaborative discussions. Translate complex storyboards into detailed visual designs that enhance learning, providing guidance to junior designers. Conduct thorough quality assurance reviews, ensuring visual consistency and functionality of eLearning materials. Audit design work for brand compliance, mentoring junior designers on adherence to brand standards. Facilitate effective teamwork by coordinating tasks and supporting team members, taking a proactive role in projects. Adapt designs in response to feedback and evolving project requirements, proactively seeking solutions to design challenges. Build strong relationships with SMRs and project teams, effectively gathering requirements and incorporating feedback. Provide mentorship to junior designers, leading by example in design projects and supporting their professional development. Foresee and proactively deal with challenges in projects Skills and Attributes for Success Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with content owners, SMRs, and other stakeholders. Excellent written and verbal communication skills; ability to articulate design concepts and engage in collaborative feedback. Ability to adapt to a constantly changing and growing business environment. Good problem-solving skills and a customer service-focused mindset. Proactive in mentoring junior team members and facilitating effective teamwork. To Qualify for the Role, You Must Have 3 to 8 years of experience in graphic design and eLearning development. Advanced proficiency with graphic design software and eLearning development tools which must include: Articulate Rise & Storyline 360 MS Word, PowerPoint, and whiteboarding applications (ie Miro/Mural/MS Whiteboard) Videos Adobe (iPDFs/Flipbooks) A foundational understanding of LMS platforms and content management. Experience building and maintaining strong relationships with business customers/clients. Ability to work in fast-paced, stressful environments to deliver required results. What We Look For An experienced graphics designer who can support multiple projects concurrently. A professional who can quickly problem-solve and offer perspective on solutions. A professional who demonstrates resilience and is energized by working in a global environment, proactively seeking different opinions and valuing diverse perspectives

title: Windchill Developer
description:
Job Title / Position: Lead - Senior Windchill Developer 
Experience: 6 - 10 years
Location: Bengaluru / Pune / Noida / Pune / Hyderabad / Chennai NP: immediate 15days joiners Senior Windchill Developer The Senior Windchill Developer will support the Ingersoll Rand Enterprise PLM program and global Windchill initiatives. This role will design, develop, integrate, and support scalable PTC Windchill solutions that improve engineering productivity and enable profitable growth. Key Responsibilities Design, develop, configure, and support Windchill solutions aligned with the Enterprise PLM strategy. Collaborate with PLM architects, IT teams, and business stakeholders to gather requirements and define solutions. Map business requirements to out-of-the-box Windchill capabilities and identify justified customization needs. Develop and customize Windchill PDMLink, including workflows, lifecycles, access controls, change management, and business rules. Configure and customize Windchill Part Classification, including classification structures, classification trees, binding attributes, reusable attributes, and classification-based search. Collaborate with engineering and business teams to define and maintain standardized part taxonomies and attribute models. Integrate Windchill with CAD applications such as Creo and AutoCAD, downstream ERP systems, and other enterprise applications. Troubleshoot application issues, perform root-cause analysis and Develop scalable, reusable, secure, and maintainable solution frameworks. Apply AI-assisted development and automation to simplify solutions, improve quality, and accelerate delivery. Maintain technical designs, deployment documentation, support procedures, and development standards. Mandatory Requirements Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field. 6 - 10 years of hands-on PTC Windchill implementation, development, and customization experience. Strong knowledge of Windchill architecture and industrial manufacturing processes. Hands-on experience with Windchill PDMLink configuration and customization. Expertise in workflows, lifecycle management, access controls, change management, and BOM management. Hands-on experience with Windchill Part Classification, including classification administration, classification trees, attribute management, reusable attributes, and classified-part search. Experience with Windchill APIs, database schemas, SQL, debugging Experience with CAD data management and PLM-CAD integration; Experience integrating Windchill with ERP systems and other enterprise applications. Proficiency in: Java/J2EE and AngularJS JSP, Servlets, MVC frameworks, and object-oriented programming RESTful and SOAP web services XML, XSD, XSLT, and JSON Unix/Linux scripting Experience using AI to enhance PLM solutions, reduce complexity, improve code quality, or accelerate development. Experience working in large-scale, global enterprise environments. Strong problem-solving, communication, presentation, and technical documentation skills.

Key Skills: WBM,Java,Windchill,Development

title: Senior Demand Planning Analyst / Consultant
description:
Role Summary Plan Optimus is looking for an experienced Demand Planning Analyst / Consultant with 4+ years of hands-on experience working with leading supply chain planning platforms such as Blue Yonder, o9 Solutions, or Kinaxis . The ideal candidate should have strong functional knowledge of demand forecasting, statistical forecasting, demand planning processes, and Integrated Business Planning (IBP). The candidate will work closely with our product development, implementation, and customer-facing teams to design, enhance, configure, and support the Plan Optimus Demand Planning solution. This role requires an individual who can independently understand business planning requirements, translate them into functional specifications, work with technical teams, and contribute to building a competitive enterprise demand planning platform. Key Responsibilities 1. Demand Planning Solution Design & Development Work with the Plan Optimus product development team to design and enhance demand planning capabilities. Translate business requirements into functional specifications, workflows, configuration requirements, and solution designs. Apply experience from Blue Yonder, o9, or Kinaxis to recommend industry-standard demand planning features and best practices. Define planning workflows, business rules, calculations, exceptions, and KPIs. Participate in solution testing, validation, and product enhancements. 2. Demand Forecasting & Analytics Support statistical forecasting, baseline forecasting, and demand forecasting processes. Understand forecasting methods, including moving averages, exponential smoothing, trend, seasonality, and machine learning-based forecasting. Analyze forecast accuracy, forecast bias, MAPE, WMAPE, and other demand planning KPIs. Support demand sensing, promotional planning, new product introductions, and product cannibalization analysis. Assist in developing exception-based planning and demand planning dashboards. 3. Demand Planning Configuration & Implementation Configure demand planning parameters, planning hierarchies, time buckets, and business rules. Support demand planning implementations, enhancements, and ongoing application support. Understand demand planning data requirements, including sales history, product hierarchies, customer hierarchies, promotional events, and external demand drivers. Collaborate with technical teams on data integration, validation, and planning calculations. Troubleshoot functional issues and recommend improvements. 4. Business Analysis & Customer Engagement Conduct requirement-gathering sessions with customers and business stakeholders. Understand existing demand planning processes and identify opportunities for improvement. Prepare functional requirement documents, solution design documents, test scenarios, and user acceptance testing plans. Conduct solution demonstrations, user training, and workshops. Work independently as a Demand Planning Subject Matter Expert (SME). 5. Product Development & Cross-Functional Collaboration Collaborate with software developers, data engineers, data scientists, and optimization specialists. Provide functional inputs for AI-enabled demand planning, scenario planning, and exception management. Work with Supply Planning, Inventory Planning, and S&OP teams to ensure integrated planning capabilities. Participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies, sprint planning, and product backlog prioritization. Mentor junior analysts and support knowledge sharing. Must-Have Skills 4+ years of experience in Demand Planning , including hands-on experience with at least one of the following:
 Blue Yonder Demand Planning o9 Solutions Demand Planning / Integrated Business Planning Kinaxis RapidResponse / Maestro Demand Planning Strong understanding of demand forecasting, statistical forecasting, and demand planning business processes. Experience configuring, implementing, enhancing, or supporting enterprise demand planning applications. Ability to translate business requirements into functional specifications and technical requirements. Experience with demand planning hierarchies, forecasting parameters, planning workflows, and exception management. Good understanding of forecast accuracy metrics, including MAPE, WMAPE, and forecast bias. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and troubleshooting skills. Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and working knowledge of SQL. Experience working with software development teams in Agile/Scrum environments. Strong communication, documentation, and stakeholder-management skills. Ability to work independently and take ownership of functional deliverables. Good-to-Have Skills Experience with Integrated Business Planning (IBP), Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP), Supply Planning, or Inventory Optimization. Experience in CPG, Food & Beverage, Retail, Quick Service Restaurants (QSR), or Distribution industries. Exposure to AI/ML-based demand forecasting and predictive analytics. Knowledge of Python, SQL, Snowflake, or modern data analytics platforms. Experience with promotional forecasting, demand sensing, new product forecasting, and cannibalization. Understanding of scenario planning, what-if analysis, and exception-based planning. Experience participating in product development for enterprise planning software. Experience conducting customer workshops, solution demonstrations, and user acceptance testing. Educational Qualifications Undergraduate: B.E. / B.Tech, B.Sc, B.Com, BBA, or equivalent qualification. Preferred: MBA in Operations / Supply Chain Management, Master's in Supply Chain Management, Industrial Engineering, or related disciplines. Ideal Candidate Profile We are particularly interested in candidates who have worked as Demand Planning Functional Consultants, Business Analysts, Solution Consultants, or Product Analysts on Blue Yonder, o9, or Kinaxis implementations. title: Talent Acquisition Specialist
description:
At Money Forward India, we are looking for a Talent Acquisition Specialist to drive technology hiring for this growth. You will own the full recruitment lifecycle for AI, full stack, QA and engineering leadership roles, and you will work closely with Engineering Managers across India and Japan. You will also help build the employer brand of a young, ambitious India engineering center in a competitive Chennai and Pune talent market. 
 
 Responsibilities 
 End-to-end hiring: Manage the full lifecycle independently, from requirement intake and sourcing strategy to screening, interview coordination, offer negotiation and onboarding handover. AI and engineering hiring: Hire for roles such as AI-Integrated Full Stack Engineers, GenAI/LLM and RAG engineers, AI Agent Platform engineers, AI QA Engineers and AI QA Leads, and Engineering Managers, including niche and hard-to-fill positions. Building new teams: Support the build-out of new engineering teams (for example, ERP cross-functional AI teams) by planning hiring in phases, defining role profiles and creating pipelines for leadership and individual contributor roles together. Talent mapping and sourcing: Map talent across SaaS, fintech, product companies, AI startups and global capability centers in Chennai and Pune. Use LinkedIn Recruiter, communities, referrals and passive outreach, and track compensation benchmarks, competitor hiring and market trends. Stakeholder partnership: Work with Engineering Managers and Japan-based leaders to calibrate requirements, design interview plans and give regular, data-backed hiring updates. Candidate experience and closing: Explain Money Forward's products, AI strategy, global engineering culture and career growth clearly to candidates, and close senior candidates professionally. Employer branding: Create LinkedIn content, referral campaigns and talent community initiatives that position Money Forward India as a strong choice for engineers who want to build AI products. AI-enabled recruitment: Use AI tools and generative AI to improve sourcing, screening and productivity, and automate repetitive recruitment work. ATS and reporting: Use Zoho Recruit to manage requisitions, pipelines and clean data. Handle everyday configuration such as job postings, email templates and Gmail-integrated interview scheduling, and report on time-to-hire, source effectiveness and offer acceptance. Process improvement: Suggest and implement improvements that make hiring faster and more consistent. 
 
 Requirements 
 
 Required Qualifications 
 5-7 years of hands-on end-to-end recruitment experience in a product-based, SaaS or fintech environment. Proven experience hiring for emerging AI roles (GenAI, LLM, RAG, AI frameworks or AI-integrated full stack) and for Engineering Managers and senior technical talent. Strong understanding of engineering skill sets and terminology, with the ability to assess and source relevant talent. Strong sourcing skills across LinkedIn Recruiter, referrals and passive channels. Working knowledge of Zoho Recruit or a comparable ATS. Excellent communication, stakeholder management and negotiation skills. Ability to work independently, manage multiple requisitions and own hiring outcomes. Analytical, adaptable and technology-oriented mindset. 
 
 Preferred Qualifications 
 Experience hiring for a newly set up India center, GCC or captive development center, including building teams from scratch. Experience working with global or Japan-based stakeholders. Hands-on experience with Zoho Recruit configuration, workflows or Gmail/Google Calendar integration. Experience with AI-powered recruitment tools and prompt engineering. Experience in employer branding, talent communities or referral programs. Experience hiring QA and testing automation talent, particularly AI QA.

title: Employee Relations Analyst
description:
About the Role We are seeking an experienced Employee Relations Analyst to support and strengthen employee relations practices across the organization. This role will be responsible for managing employee relations cases, conducting workplace investigations, providing HR consulting support, ensuring compliance with employment laws and company policies, and analyzing trends to drive positive employee experiences and business outcomes.
 Employee Relations Case Management Manage end-to-end employee relations cases, ensuring timely and appropriate resolution. Maintain accurate and comprehensive case documentation. Interpret and apply company policies and employment laws to employee relations matters. Assess risk, recommend appropriate actions, and escalate cases when necessary. Partner with employees, leaders, and HR stakeholders to resolve workplace concerns. 
 Employee Relations Consulting & Guidance Provide expert guidance to managers and HR partners on employee relations matters. Advise on corrective action plans, performance concerns, and disciplinary processes. Support involuntary termination processes and related documentation. Build strong relationships and credibility with business leaders and stakeholders. Deliver training and coaching on employee relations practices and HR processes. Support employee relations programs and organizational initiatives. 
 Workplace Investigations Conduct and manage investigations involving workplace concerns such as misconduct, harassment, discrimination, policy violations, and other employee complaints. Interview employees, managers, and relevant stakeholders to gather facts and documentation. Prepare investigation findings and recommend appropriate actions. Coach managers and HR partners on investigation best practices. Support implementation and communication of new or updated policies. 
 Reporting & Data Analysis Analyze employee relations trends, case volumes, and workplace concerns. Prepare reports and dashboards for leaders and stakeholders. Identify emerging issues and recommend proactive solutions. Utilize data insights to improve employee relations effectiveness and reduce organizational risk. 
 Audit & Compliance Support Support internal and external audits related to employment practices and compliance requirements. Respond to regulatory and compliance-related information requests. Ensure adherence to applicable labor laws, company policies, and compliance standards. 
 Workforce Change & Downsizing Support Assist leaders with workforce reduction and organizational change initiatives. Support impact assessments, documentation, employee communication, and separation processes. Coordinate severance-related activities and reporting requirements. Partner with HR, Legal, and business stakeholders throughout the process. 

 Required Qualifications Bachelor's /Master's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field. 4+ years of experience in Employee Relations, Human Resources, Employment Law, or a related HR function. Experience conducting workplace investigations and managing complex employee relations cases. Strong knowledge of employment laws, disciplinary processes, and HR best practices. Experience advising managers on employee performance, conduct, and workplace issues. Proven ability to build effective cross-functional relationships across multiple levels and geographies. Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills. Proficiency with HR systems, case management tools, and Microsoft Office applications.

Key Skills: Employee Engagement,Employee Satisfaction,Employee Welfare,Employee Counseling,Employee Development,Employee Retention,Employee Involvement,Culture Building

description:
Job Summary 
 The opportunity: Analyst-AMI-TAX-TAX - Indirect Tax - Core - New Delhi. 
 
 Overview 
 The Advanced Manufacturing, Mobility Infrastructure (AMI) Industry Market contains the following industries: Aerospace and Defence, Chemicals, Infrastructure, Industrial Products, Automotive, and Transportation that includes Mobility-as-a-Service. We help our clients to address the rapidly changing needs of our business world on not only how goods and services are bought and sold, but also on how they are designed and created. AMI builds and shares resources across sectors facing common challenges and aims to drive more effective cross-sector collaboration while enabling greater resource-pooling and developing more cohesive market responses. AMI also presents an opportunity to connect regional sector communities with a more robust, global priority sector infrastructure. TAX - Indirect Tax - Core : Our globally coordinated tax professionals offer connected services across all tax disciplines to help the clients thrive in an era of rapid change. We combine our exceptional knowledge and experience with the people and technology platforms to equip clients in making better business decisions by bringing insights to the forefront. We help companies understand the tax policies and tax laws of governments around the world to plan and comply accordingly. Our teams leverage transformative technologies to deliver strategy and execution, from tax and regulatory obligations to operations and workforce management, to reduce risk and drive sustainable value. We have competencies in Business Tax Services, Global Compliance and Reporting, Global Law, Indirect Tax, International Tax and Transaction Services. 
 
 Responsibilities 
 Demonstrated working knowledge of GST provisions, including registration, returns filing, input tax credit, and invoicing requirements. Proficient in using Microsoft Excel for tax data analysis, reconciliations, and preparation of compliance schedules. Able to interpret indirect tax legislation and apply it accurately to client transactions and compliance scenarios. Understanding of GST reconciliation processes, including GSTR-2B, GSTR-1, and GSTR-3B matching. Good-to-have exposure to GST litigation, including drafting replies to notices and supporting assessment or appeal proceedings. 
 
 Skills and qualifications 
 
 To qualify for the role you must have 
 Master of Business Administration Master of Commerce Certification in Data Analytics Bachelor of Business Administration Bachelor of Commerce 
 
 Experience 
 1-2 years of work experience/ internship/ articleship experience 
 
 What we look for 
 People with the ability to work in a collaborative manner to provide services across multiple client departments while following the commercial and legal requirements. You will need a practical approach to solving issues and complex problems with the ability to deliver insightful and practical solutions. We look for people who are agile, curious, mindful, and able to sustain positive energy, while being adaptable and creative in their approach.

title: Technical Delivery Coordinator
description:
Role Positioning The Technical Delivery Coordinator provides delivery operations and coordination support for technology programs and initiatives. The role maintains delivery controls, schedules, dependencies, action plans, readiness activities, reporting, and project records to provide accurate and timely visibility into delivery progress. By proactively tracking commitments, monitoring dependencies, coordinating follow-up actions, and escalating emerging concerns, the Technical Delivery Coordinator enables the Program Manager to focus on delivery leadership, stakeholder engagement, governance, risk management, and strategic decision-making. This position serves as the central coordination point for delivery administration and operational execution support but is not accountable for program outcomes, scope decisions, budget authority, resource allocation, delivery commitments, vendor negotiations, or strategic technology decisions. The role is expected to identify potential issues early, ensure information remains accurate and current, and provide the structured follow-through necessary to support predictable and successful technology delivery. Position Summary The Technical Delivery Coordinator is a detail-oriented delivery support professional responsible for maintaining project plans, timelines, trackers, documentation, meeting follow-up, and day-to-day delivery controls across technology initiatives. The coordinator works under the direction of the Program Manager and partners with development, QA, business, operations, vendors, and other assigned resources to ensure commitments are documented, monitored, and followed through to completion. Operating Model The Technical Delivery Coordinator serves as the operational delivery support partner to the Program Manager. The coordinator maintains delivery controls, follow-through, project documentation, reporting, and readiness activities while the Program Manager retains accountability for scope, priorities, budget, resource allocation, stakeholder management, and program outcomes. Primary Outcomes Project plans and milestone dates are current, accurate, and supported by named owners and dependencies. Upcoming deliverables, overdue actions, blockers, and decisions are visible before they become missed commitments. Meeting actions, requirements questions, risks, and issues are documented and followed through to closure. Teams receive timely reminders, clear assignments, and organized documentation needed to execute the work. The Program Manager receives concise, decision-ready updates and can focus on higher-priority client, vendor, business, and delivery escalations. Core Responsibilities Project Planning and Schedule Maintenance Create and maintain project plans, implementation timelines, milestone schedules, workback plans, and task trackers using approved templates and tools. 
 FIMC Job Description | Technical Delivery Coordinator | Page 2 
 Break approved deliverables into trackable activities with owners, target dates, dependencies, status, and completion evidence. Collect estimates and sequencing information from assigned team members and update the plan based on direction from the Program Manager or technical lead. Monitor planned versus actual dates and identify tasks that are late, at risk, missing an owner, or dependent on unresolved work. Maintain near-term look-ahead views for upcoming deadlines, testing windows, releases, client commitments, and vendor deliverables. Prepare proposed schedule updates when dates shift, clearly showing the reason, affected milestones, downstream impact, and required decision. Delivery Tracking and Follow-Through Obtain regular status updates from task owners and keep project records current without waiting for the Program Manager to request each update. Follow up on open tasks, overdue actions, unanswered questions, approvals, test results, documentation, and delivery commitments. Maintain action, decision, risk, issue, assumption, dependency, and change logs as required for each initiative. Confirm that completed items have the expected documentation or evidence before marking them complete. Track cross-team handoffs and verify that receiving teams have the information, access, files, environments, or approvals needed to begin their work. Raise concerns promptly when updates are not received, dates are likely to be missed, requirements are incomplete, or ownership is unclear. Risk, Issue, and Dependency Coordination Identify and document delivery risks, blockers, resource conflicts, unresolved dependencies, environment constraints, and missing decisions. Capture the issue, business or delivery impact, owner, target date, mitigation action, and escalation need in plain language. Follow up with owners on mitigation actions and bring overdue or ineffective actions to the Program Manager for direction. Prepare concise escalation summaries that state what happened, what is affected, what has been attempted, available options, and the decision needed. Monitor dependencies across business, development, QA, operations, vendors, and client activities and flag sequencing conflicts early. Meeting and Communication Support Prepare agendas, status materials, open-item lists, and decision questions for project meetings. Attend assigned meetings, document decisions and action items, and distribute clear notes with owners and dates. Maintain recurring meeting cadence, cancel unnecessary meetings with approval, and ensure unresolved items are carried forward. Draft routine project communications, reminders, status updates, and follow-up messages for Program Manager review when required. Organize project information so stakeholders can quickly understand current status, next steps, open risks, and items requiring their input. Requirements, Tickets, and Documentation Readiness Review project requests and work items for required information, including objective, scope, business need, owner, acceptance criteria, dependencies, target date, and supporting documentation. Identify incomplete, conflicting, or unclear information and route questions to the appropriate business or technical owner before work is scheduled. Coordinate the movement of approved work through intake, planning, development, testing, release, and closure stages based on the established process. Maintain organized project folders, meeting notes, requirements, approvals, test evidence, release records, and decision history. Ensure project trackers, tickets, and status reports use consistent terminology and reflect the same dates, owners, and current status. Testing, Release, and Implementation Coordination 
 FIMC Job Description | Technical Delivery Coordinator | Page 3 
 Coordinate test schedules, tester assignments, environment readiness, defect follow-up, retesting dates, and sign-off tracking under the direction of the Program Manager and QA lead. Maintain readiness checklists for requirements, development completion, testing, approvals, communications, implementation, rollback, and post-release validation. Confirm that required participants understand their assigned implementation steps and timing before a release or launch. Track implementation actions and post-production follow-up, including stabilization items, defects, documentation, and handoff to support. Escalate missed readiness criteria or unresolved defects before planned releases. Vendor and Cross-Functional Coordination Track vendor deliverables, due dates, open questions, requested documentation, testing dependencies, and follow-up actions. Coordinate routine information exchange among business teams, technology teams, QA, operations, and vendors. Maintain a record of vendor commitments and identify conflicts between vendor dates and internal delivery plans. Prepare supporting information for vendor or client discussions while the Program Manager retains ownership of sensitive negotiations, escalations, and relationship decisions. Route requests and issues to the correct owner and verify that responses are received and recorded. Status Reporting and Project Administration Prepare weekly status reports and dashboards showing schedule health, completed work, upcoming milestones, overdue items, risks, issues, decisions, and support needed. Validate status information against source trackers and task-owner updates before distribution. Maintain project calendars, contact lists, distribution lists, recurring reminders, and standard templates. Assist with tracking project hours, purchase requests, invoices, budget updates, or vendor records when assigned; escalate discrepancies for review. Support project closeout by confirming deliverables, approvals, documentation, lessons learned, and remaining operational actions are recorded. Decision Authority and Escalation Boundaries 
 Expected to Own Escalate for Direction or Approval 
 Plan and tracker maintenance • Scope, priority, or budget changes Routine follow-up and reminders • Final delivery-date commitments Meeting agendas, notes, and actions • Client, vendor, or executive escalations Status collection and reporting • Contract, SLA, or commercial decisions Risk and issue documentation • Resource assignments outside approved plans Documentation organization and quality checks • Acceptance of material risk or release exceptions Readiness checklist coordination • Sensitive performance or personnel matters 
 FIMC Job Description | Technical Delivery Coordinator | Page 4 
 Required Skills and Competencies Strong organization, follow-through, prioritization, and attention to detail across multiple concurrent workstreams. Ability to build and maintain practical project plans, schedules, action logs, risk and issue logs, status reports, and readiness checklists. Ability to recognize a late task, missing dependency, unclear owner, incomplete requirement, or conflicting date and raise it promptly. Clear, concise written communication and professional follow-up with business, technical, client-facing, and vendor teams. Comfort working with software delivery activities such as requirements, development, QA, UAT, defects, releases, and production support. Working knowledge of Agile and traditional project-delivery practices without requiring the role to function as a Scrum Master or senior Project Manager. Ability to use project and collaboration tools such as Jira, Confluence, Azure DevOps, Microsoft Planner, Microsoft Project, Smartsheet, Excel, Teams, or comparable tools. Ability to handle confidential information, meet deadlines, and maintain accurate records in a remote work environment. Minimum Qualifications Associate or bachelors degree in business, technology, project management, information systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 2+ years of experience in project coordination, PMO support, technology operations, business analysis support, implementation coordination, or a related role. Experience maintaining project schedules, action items, status reports, meeting notes, and project documentation. Experience coordinating across multiple teams and following up on deliverables, dependencies, and due dates. Proficiency with Microsoft 365 applications and at least one project, ticketing, or work-management platform. Preferred Experience Experience supporting technology, software, API/integration, SaaS, data, infrastructure, or client implementation projects. Experience working with remote, distributed, or vendor-supported teams. Familiarity with Jira, Confluence, Azure DevOps, ServiceNow, Smartsheet, Microsoft Project, or similar platforms. CAPM, Certified Associate in Scrum, or comparable entry-to-intermediate project coordination training is helpful but not required. Performance Expectations Keeps assigned plans, trackers, and status information current and reliable. Follows through on commitments and escalates concerns early rather than after a deadline is missed. Produces clear meeting notes, action items, and status updates with accurate owners and dates. Reduces administrative follow-up required from the Program Manager by proactively obtaining updates and organizing the work. Uses sound judgment about what can be handled through routine coordination and what requires escalation.

With a global team of over 4,000 highly skilled developers, consultants, analysts and product owners, we engineer technology that redefines industries and shapes the way people live.

Recently, modifications were required to adapt the CC platform to Hydra, which involved small PCB shape changes and corresponding updates in the firmware. During this process, it became evident that the firmware would benefit from applying modern coding practices and testing methodologies to make the Cleaning Center platform more future-proof, flexible, and easier to update.

Additionally, the 1Interface initiative has already paved the way for the integration of connected cleaning stations in the future. 
 The natural next step in this journey is to renew the firmware and codebase for Hydra2, establishing a robust foundation. Once this renewal is complete, the platform can serve as a springboard for further innovations and product evolutions in connected cleaning technology.

Department Profile The cornerstone of Morgan Stanleys risk management philosophy is the execution of risk-adjusted returns through prudent risk-taking that protects Morgan Stanley’s capital base and franchise. Risk Management protects the firm from exposure to losses resulting from market volatilities and defaults by our lending and trading counterparties. description:
Python Automation Developer (Playwright, Web Scraping and Local LLMs) 
 Contact:- rajiv.phanse@service1stbpm.com 
 We are looking for a Python Developer to expand the coverage of our title-search automation platform. The platform uses Playwright to retrieve records from county recorder and public-record portals. It validates the data it collects, and it uses locally hosted LLMs to extract text and generate reports from search packets. You will build and maintain new portal and jurisdiction modules and the extraction and validation pipelines behind them. You will own these from design through production. Key Responsibilities Build and maintain Playwright-based scrapers for county recorder, assessor, and other public-record portals, including login flows, dynamic pages, pagination, and downloads. Make scrapers resilient to site changes, with retries, session handling, rate limiting, and clear logging. Extract text and structured fields from PDF search packets and scanned documents (parsing, OCR, layout handling). Use local LLMs (LM Studio/Bionic, Ollama, or Unsloth fine-tuned models) to extract fields, classify documents, and generate summaries and reports. This includes prompt design and structured JSON output. Using the extracted content implement RAG system in the production pipeline. Validate extracted and scraped data against source documents, with rule-based checks and LLM-assisted checks. Flag mismatches, missing records, and low-confidence results for review. Expand coverage by adding new counties and jurisdictions, and by handling new document types and portal variations. Build evaluation sets from real packets, and measure and improve extraction accuracy. Write unit and regression tests for parsers, scrapers, and validation logic. Use fixtures so tests do not depend on live portals. Document modules, portal quirks, and assumptions so the team can maintain them. Work with domain experts (title examiners and abstractors) to turn their rules into reliable code. Required Skills and Qualifications 3-5 years of Python development, including at least 2 years of web scraping or browser automation. Hands-on Playwright experience (Selenium or Puppeteer is acceptable if Playwright is learned quickly), including async Python. Strong skills in HTML/DOM parsing, network inspection, and handling dynamic, session-based websites. Experience with PDF and document text extraction (PyMuPDF, pdfplumber, Tesseract or other OCR). Practical experience running local LLMs with LM Studio (Bionic), Ollama, Unsloth, or similar tools, and prompting them for extraction and report generation. Data validation skills: regex, schema validation (Pydantic), fuzzy matching, and normalization of names, dates, and legal descriptions. Good command of pandas, JSON, and Excel/CSV output, and comfort with Git. Ability to debug flaky, rate-limited, or inconsistent data sources methodically. Preferred Skills Fine-tuning small models with Unsloth (LoRA/QLoRA) on domain-specific data. Experience with GPU and quantized model setups (GGUF, llama.cpp) and tuning throughput on limited hardware. Knowledge of real estate, title, or land-records concepts such as chain of title, deeds, mortgages, liens, and legal descriptions. Experience building evaluation harnesses or golden datasets for LLM extraction. Familiarity with desktop or CLI tooling (Tauri, Electron, or packaged Python apps) and with scheduled or batch pipelines. Experience with compliant scraping practices, including respecting terms of use and rate limits. What Success Looks Like New jurisdictions go live quickly, and their extraction accuracy is measured and tracked. Packet processing needs less manual review, and the team can trust the validation flags. Models and prompts improve by iteration against real data, not by guesswork.

 Key Responsibilities 
 
 Platform Engineering

Lead technical design and implementation activities for strategic platform initiatives.  Kubernetes Cloud-Native Platforms

Drive automation-first approaches for provisioning, configuration management, upgrades, compliance validation, and operational support. Build repeatable deployment patterns that reduce operational effort while improving consistency and quality. 
 
 DevSecOps Platform Reliability 
 Integrate security, compliance, and operational controls into platform delivery processes. Implement CI/CD pipelines supporting infrastructure, platform services, and Kubernetes lifecycle activities. Support vulnerability management, policy enforcement, secrets management, and certificate management capabilities. Define and improve platform reliability, availability, observability, backup, and recovery capabilities. 
 
 Qualification, Testing Continuous Improvement 
 Develop automated validation and qualification frameworks for: Kubernetes releases Infrastructure profiles Storage integrations Network integrations Security controls Platform services Edge deployments GPU-enabled configurations Contribute to platform certification and supportability programs. Support development of platform standards, support matrices, and operational runbooks. Drive continuous improvement through automation, standardization, measurement, and operational feedback. 
 
 Collaboration Technical Leadership 
 Partner with architects, security teams, infrastructure teams, operations teams, and application teams to deliver platform capabilities. Participate in architecture reviews and technology evaluations. Help define engineering roadmaps and implementation plans. Contribute to platform strategy through practical implementation experience and operational insights. 
 
 Minimum Qualifications

Experience in Platform Engineering, Cloud Engineering, DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), Infrastructure Engineering, or related technical disciplines. Strong knowledge of AWS and/or Azure cloud platforms. Hands-on experience with Kubernetes platforms such as Amazon EKS, Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), OpenShift, RKE2, or equivalent enterprise Kubernetes platforms Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform preferred), CI/CD pipelines, GitOps, Linux administration, Containers and container platforms, Cloud networking and security, Observability and monitoring solutions Experience implementing highly available, secure, and scalable platform solutions.  Preferred Qualifications

Strong scripting and automation skills using Python, PowerShell, Bash, JavaScript, or similar technologies. Relevant cloud, DevOps, Terraform, Kubernetes, or security certifications.

Successful implementation of cloud and Kubernetes platform services aligned to roadmap objectives. Increased automation and reduction of manual operational effort. Improved platform reliability, security, scalability, and supportability. Reduced onboarding time for applications, environments, and infrastructure consumers. Effective qualification, testing, and lifecycle management of platform technologies. Successful mentoring and technical leadership of engineering teams. Measurable improvement in platform adoption, operational efficiency, and delivery velocity. This role offers an opportunity to shape the future of cloud, Kubernetes, platform engineering, and edge computing capabilities while remaining deeply engaged in hands-on technical delivery and engineering leadership.

description:
SAISYSTEMS HEALTH • ENTERPRISE CLAIMS MANAGEMENT (ECM) 
 Senior Full Stack Developer AI-Forward Development (.NET & Angular) 
Saisystems Health is hiring an AI-forward Full Stack Developer with 5+ years of .NET and Angular experience and a US healthcare background to build and modernise ECM, our enterprise claims management platform.
 Position at a glance 
 DetailValueRole Senior Full Stack Developer AI-Forward Development (ECM) Openings 2 Experience 5+ years professional full stack development (.NET + Angular) Domain US healthcare revenue cycle management (RCM), medical billing, HIPAA Location Pune, India Saisystems Health offshore development centre Work model Work from office (on-site, full working week) Employment type Full-time permanent employee Reports to Development Manager, ECM Engineering Product ECM Enterprise Claims Management (US healthcare revenue cycle) Core stack Angular 18 • .NET 8 / C# 12 • Azure SQL • Microsoft Azure AI tooling Claude / Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT / OpenAI Codex, Cursor, Gemini, Perplexity About the role 
This is a hands-on full stack role where AI-assisted engineering is part of the job, not an optional extra. You will own tickets end to end from design conversation through testing to production support using AI coding assistants and agents to deliver faster while holding the quality and compliance bar of a regulated healthcare product.
 The product. ECM manages the full claim lifecycle for US healthcare provider organisations: patient and encounter capture, coding and charge entry, eligibility, a configurable business-rules engine, clearinghouse claim transmission, ERA/835 payment posting, denial and AR work queues, patient statements, credentialing and executive reporting.
 The engineering problem. ECM is a mature, high-volume, multi-tenant SaaS platform with tens of millions of claim and transaction rows, external BI consumers on the same database, and scheduled automation running alongside the API. The work mixes new feature delivery with deliberate modernisation performance, observability, test coverage, security hardening and technical-debt reduction in a system that cannot stop running.
 Why AI-forward. We use AI across the engineering lifecycle and want engineers who already work this way: using agents and assistants to understand a large codebase, scaffold and refactor code, generate tests, review SQL and document changes and who can explain every line they commit.
 Key responsibilities 
 Front end (Angular) 
 Build and enhance Angular screens data grids, forms, multi-step claim and payment workflows, filters, dashboards and exports that stay usable on large result sets.
 Work within a large existing codebase using NgRx state management, RxJS and component-driven design, refactoring incrementally rather than rewriting.
¢ Implement role-driven UI that respects access control and minimum-necessary display of sensitive data.
 Back end (.NET) and database 
¢ Implement ASP.NET Core Web API endpoints and service-layer logic (controller interface service) over stored procedures.
¢ Write and tune T-SQL procedures, views and queries against tables with tens of millions of rows; design indexes and read execution plans.
¢ Reason about locking and concurrency against simultaneous BI reads and scheduled background jobs.
¢ Build and maintain healthcare integrations: inbound and outbound X12 EDI (837, 835, 277CA, 999), clearinghouse SFTP exchange, ERA auto-posting and payer interfaces.
 AI-forward development 
¢ Use AI coding assistants and agents (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Codex or similar) daily for codebase exploration, scaffolding, refactoring, unit-test generation, SQL and code review, debugging and documentation.
¢ Treat all AI output as a draft: review, test and understand it before committing; apply extra scrutiny to AI-assisted changes to stored procedures and production data paths.
¢ Identify and prototype practical AI use cases in the product and the development workflow for example, test-case design, requirement clarification and release notes within approved, compliant tooling.
¢ Share prompts, workflows and lessons learned so the whole team gets faster.
 Quality, operations and compliance 
¢ Diagnose production issues using Application Insights, logs and Query Store, and fix root causes.
¢ Write unit tests for new logic (xUnit, Moq, Jasmine/Karma) and partner with QA on regression coverage.
¢ Participate in code review as author and reviewer, and assess pre-merge impact across the develop QA UAT staging production pipeline.
¢ Follow HIPAA and secure-by-default practices: no PHI in logs, tickets, screenshots or AI tools; secrets in Key Vault; least-privilege access.
¢ Contribute to performance, quality and technical-debt work alongside feature delivery.
 Collaboration 
¢ Work from written requirements with US-based product and business stakeholders, ask clarifying questions and give realistic estimates.
¢ Write clear design notes, PR descriptions and status updates that support asynchronous, cross-time-zone work.
 Required qualifications 
 Experience 
¢ 5+ years of professional full stack development with .NET and Angular in production systems.
¢ 2+ years working on US healthcare software revenue cycle management, medical billing, claims, practice management, EHR or payer systems.
 .NET and database 
¢ Strong C# and ASP.NET Core Web API (.NET 6 or later); comfortable with Entity Framework Core and/or Dapper.
¢ Working SQL Server / T-SQL: can write a non-trivial stored procedure, read a query plan and explain why a query is slow.
 Angular 
¢ Strong Angular (12+) with TypeScript, RxJS and component-driven design; able to work in a large existing codebase without rewriting it.
 AI-forward engineering 
¢ Demonstrated daily use of at least one AI development platform Claude / Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT / Codex, Cursor or similar for code generation, refactoring, test writing, debugging and documentation.
¢ Effective prompting and context management on a large, unfamiliar codebase, not just generic snippets.
¢ Verification discipline: can explain every line committed, and can show examples of catching and correcting flawed AI output.
 Healthcare domain 
¢ Working knowledge of the claim lifecycle: charge entry, claim submission, adjudication, remittance, denials and AR follow-up.
¢ Familiarity with HIPAA X12 transactions (837, 835, 277CA, 999) and CMS-1500 / UB-04 claim formats.
¢ Understanding of HIPAA Privacy and Security Rule obligations and how they shape logging, access control and data handling.
 Engineering practice 
¢ Git, pull-request workflow and CI/CD (Azure DevOps or similar).
¢ Ability to work from written requirements, ask good clarifying questions and give realistic estimates.
¢ Willing to work from the Pune office full time.
 Preferred qualifications 
¢ Experience with agentic AI workflows (for example, Claude Code or Copilot agents) for multi-file changes, test generation or code migration.
¢ Experience integrating LLM APIs (Azure OpenAI, Anthropic, OpenAI) into .NET applications prompt design, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), structured output and evaluation within HIPAA-compliant boundaries.
¢ Exposure to AI use cases in RCM such as denial prediction, coding assistance, document extraction or claim scrubbing.
¢ Microsoft Azure services: App Service, WebJobs, Blob Storage, Key Vault, Service Bus, Redis, Application Insights, Entra ID.
¢ NgRx or another Redux-style state library; SignalR or other real-time patterns.
¢ EDI tooling such as EdiFabric; SFTP and clearinghouse integrations.
¢ xUnit / NUnit / Jasmine-Karma testing experience.
¢ Reporting or BI exposure (Power BI, SSRS).
¢ Certifications (any of): Microsoft Azure Developer Associate (AZ-204), Azure AI Engineer Associate (AI-102), or a healthcare credential such as AAPC or HFMA coursework.
 
 Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field or equivalent demonstrable professional experience. What you have built and shipped counts more than the credential.
 Technology stack 
This is the production stack. Depth in front end, API, database and AI tooling matters most; the rest can be learned on the job.
 LayerTechnologiesWhat you will do with itFront end Angular 18, TypeScript, RxJS 7, NgRx 18, Angular Material & CDK, Bootstrap 5, SCSS, Highcharts, SignalR clientBuild and refactor billing and clinical screens, large data grids, multi-step workflows, dashboards and exports API .NET 8 / C# 12, ASP.NET Core Web API, EF Core 8, Dapper, SignalR, xUnit + Moq, SerilogAdd endpoints, refactor oversized services, raise service-layer test coverage Database Azure SQL Database, T-SQL, SSDT, Query Store, stored procedures, views, functionsWrite and tune procedures, design indexes, analyse plans, manage locking against BI reads Cloud & platform Azure App Service, WebJobs, Blob Storage, Key Vault, Service Bus, Redis, Application Insights, Entra IDConfiguration and secrets, background workers, telemetry, production diagnosis Healthcare integration EdiFabric (X12 / HIPAA), SSH.NET (SFTP), MailKit, Twilio, RestSharp, ClosedXMLEDI 837/835/277CA/999 processing, clearinghouse exchange, statements and payer interfaces AI tooling Claude / Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT / OpenAI Codex, Cursor, Gemini, PerplexityCode generation, refactoring, test authoring, code and SQL review, research, documentation Engineering process Git, Azure DevOps (Repos, Pipelines, Boards), Jira, multi-stage promotionBranching, code review, CI/CD, release readiness, pre-merge impact assessment Core competencies and success measures 
 Ways of working 
¢ Evidence over assertion claims about performance or impact are backed by a measurement or a source reference.
¢ Production respect the system handles live claims and money; changes are weighed for their effect on real data before merge.
¢ Clear written communication design notes, PR descriptions and status that someone outside your head can follow.
¢ Cross-time-zone collaboration close work with US-based product and business stakeholders; asynchronous clarity matters as much as meetings.
¢ Continuous learning keeping current with AI tooling as it changes how this work is done.
 What success looks like 
 TimeframeOutcomeFirst 30 days Environment set up; HIPAA training complete; first tickets shipped through the full pipeline with AI-assisted workflow in place First 90 days Owning features end to end across Angular, .NET and T-SQL; contributing to code review; at least one measurable performance or test-coverage improvement First 6 months Trusted owner of an ECM module or integration area; sharing AI workflows and prompts with the team; helping reduce technical debt Timeframes are suggested targets for the hiring manager to confirm. 
 Compliance, security and responsible AI use 
¢ ECM processes Protected Health Information (PHI). All engineers complete HIPAA training and are bound by Saisystems Health security and confidentiality policies.
¢ No PHI, patient data, credentials, production connection strings or confidential business data is ever entered into an external or unapproved AI tool.
¢ AI is an accelerator, not a substitute for engineering judgement; accountability for correctness stays with the engineer.
¢ AI-generated code is reviewed to the same standard as hand-written code, with added scrutiny for stored procedures and production data paths.
¢ Secure-by-default habits: no PHI in logs, tickets, screenshots or non-production data; least-privilege access; secrets in Key Vault, never in source.
¢ Design decisions account for audit, access control and data-retention requirements of a regulated product.
¢ Employment is subject to a background check and a signed confidentiality agreement.

Job Description 
 Title: Tech Lead / Engineering Lead

 Location: Sector 55, Gurugram (On-site, 5 days)

 About Master-O: 
Master-O is a sales enablement platform used by leading enterprises across industries like FMCG, Pharma, Banking, Insurance, Automotive, Retail, Technology etc. to drive the capability development and frontline readiness for their customer-facing teams with the help of microlearning, game-based assessments and AI-powered conversational roleplays.
As we continue to expand our enterprise deployments across Pan India, North America, Middle East, and Southeast Asia, we are looking for a Tech Lead to take ownership of our engineering function and drive the successful delivery, implementation, and scalability of our solution.
 
 The Role: 
This is a high-ownership role for someone who enjoys building features, solving complex engineering problems, and collaborating with internal teams and customers. You will be leading a team of 5-6 developers and will be the face of the engineering function at Master-O.
Reporting directly to the Founder, this role requires someone who can balance engineering excellence with business priorities and ensure reliable delivery across multiple enterprise clients and geographies.
We are particularly interested in people who have prior worked in a growing SaaS organisation or have entrepreneurial experience and understand what it takes to build and deliver features from scratch.
 
 Key Responsibilities: 
 1. Engineering Leadership & Technical Ownership Own the engineering function, including architecture, development, code quality, performance, scalability, security, and maintenance. Lead a team of 5-6 engineers, providing technical direction, reviewing code, ensuring timely delivery and nurturing their career path. Remain hands-on with development and debugging rather than functioning solely as a people manager. Establish engineering standards, development practices, testing protocols, and release processes. Make pragmatic technology decisions that balance long-term scalability with ad-hoc business requirements. 
 2. Enterprise Implementations & Client Delivery Own the technical execution of our implementations with enterprise clients across the globe. Drive client-specific configurations, integrations, customizations, deployments, and production rollouts. Work closely with the Founder, Customer Success team, Product team, and other key stakeholders to translate client requirements into robust technical outcomes. Troubleshoot complex production issues, manage technical dependencies within team, and ensure implementation timelines and quality standards are met. Build reusable frameworks and integration capabilities that reduce implementation time and minimize repetitive custom development. 
 3. AI Engineering & Emerging Technologies Evaluate and implement AI capabilities that solve real enterprise problems and enhance product functionality. Experience integrating Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and AI agents into enterprise applications will be a strong advantage. Understand the practical considerations of deploying AI in production, including data security, reliability, latency, cost, and evaluation. Encourage responsible adoption of AI coding tools such as Claude Code while ensuring engineers retain strong fundamentals, understand the code they ship, and take ownership of its quality. 
 4. Team & Execution Management Take ownership of engineering priorities, sprint execution, resource allocation, and delivery commitments. Build a culture of accountability, ownership, collaboration, and continuous improvement. Ensure the team can independently diagnose and resolve technical problems rather than relying excessively on external tools or generated code. Collaborate with leadership to align engineering priorities with customer commitments, product roadmaps, and business objectives. 
 Required Technical Skills: 
 Strong hands-on experience with Node.js, Express.js, React, MySQL, Python, and AWS. Solid understanding of backend architecture, REST APIs, database design, system integrations, and cloud-based deployments. Experience building, maintaining, and scaling production-grade mobile and web applications. Strong debugging, code review, system design, and performance optimization skills. Familiarity with software development lifecycle practices, version control, automated testing, CI/CD, and production monitoring. Ability to make independent technical decisions and take ownership of issues from identification through resolution. 
 Experience & Qualifications: 
 8-10 years of relevant software engineering experience, with demonstrated progression into technical leadership. Prior experience leading a team of junior and mid-level engineers. Experience in a B2B SaaS company or an enterprise technology environment is strongly preferred. Experience managing enterprise client implementations, integrations, and production deployments. B.Tech / B.E. in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related engineering discipline, preferably from a Tier-1 engineering college. 
 What We Are Looking For: 
We are looking for a seasoned engineering professional who has experience handling multiple clients, varied integration requirements, competing priorities, and production issues.
You must be flexible to coordinate across time zones and work outside standard business hours when client implementations or critical releases require it.
This role offers the opportunity to work closely with the Founder, influence the product and architecture decisions, lead a compact engineering team, and directly shape how our technology scales across enterprise customers in not just domestic but international markets.

title: Senior Software Engineer (Go/Kubernetes & Applied AI)
description:
Software Developer 
 About the opportunity The organisation we deliver outcome-based cloud solutions that help customers modernise applications, launch new products, and run complex cloud environments. RackAI is our strategic platform for bringing secure, scalable, cloud-native AI capabilities to customers and internal teams alike. We're looking for an expert Software Developer to join the PVC Product Software Engineering team and help design and evolve the core of RackAI. You'll pair deep Go and Kubernetes expertise with genuine architectural leadership and you'll help set the standard for how a modern engineering team builds software in the age of AI. It's a hands-on senior role: strategic enough to shape direction, close enough to the code to lead by example. Put simply: we build AI, and we build with AI. If you want to work at the intersection of cloud-native platform engineering and applied AI and help define an AI-first engineering culture — this is the seat. 
 Why RackAI You'll help shape the future of AI-powered products at the organisation — building with modern cloud-native technology, solving hard problems at scale, and setting the standard for how engineering teams work in an AI-first world. 
 What you'll do Architect and build the RackAI platform Design and develop highly scalable backend services in Go (Golang) . Build Kubernetes-native applications — operators, controllers, and platform services — using controller-runtime and kubebuilder. Define and evolve the RackAI platform architecture for growth, reliability, security, and operational excellence. Develop the APIs, automation frameworks, and platform capabilities that power AI-enabled products. Champion cloud-native best practices: observability, resiliency, and operational readiness. Lead an AI-first engineering culture Make AI-assisted engineering the default way of working — champion an AI-driven, AI-first approach across the team. Embed AI development tooling — Claude Code , Kiro , Codex , or GitHub Copilot — across the lifecycle, from design and coding through testing, review, and documentation. Set the standards and guardrails for responsible, effective use of AI coding assistants — code quality, security, licensing, and human-in-the-loop review. Turn AI augmentation into measurable gains in velocity and quality through prompt engineering and agentic workflows. Coach engineers to get real leverage from AI tooling, and continually assess what to adopt next. Engineer the platform and infrastructure Design and optimise Kubernetes deployments across multiple environments. Automate provisioning, deployment, scaling, and lifecycle management. Partner with Platform Engineering to raise developer productivity and platform reliability. Ensure solutions meet security, compliance, and operational requirements. Lead and mentor Provide technical leadership across multiple engineering teams. Lead architectural reviews and design discussions, and set coding standards and patterns. Mentor Software Developers I–III and grow engineering capability across the group. Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend strategic investments. Collaborate across the organisation Work closely with Product, Architecture, Data Science, SRE, and Security. Translate business needs into scalable technical solutions. Communicate architectural decisions and technical strategy to stakeholders. Contribute to roadmap planning and long-term platform evolution. 
 What you'll bring Core software engineering Expert-level Go (Golang) development. Deep Kubernetes expertise — architecture, operations, and application development. Proven experience with distributed systems and microservices architectures. Strong command of RESTful APIs, event-driven systems, and service-oriented architecture. Hands-on with container technologies such as Docker and OCI-compliant runtimes. Solid grounding in software design patterns, CI/CD, DevOps, Git-based workflows, and secure coding practices. Experience 2 to 10 years in software development, including 2- or 3-years writing production Go. Demonstrable experience building Kubernetes operators or controllers with controller-runtime or kubebuilder. A track record of delivering production-grade cloud-native applications. Experience leading complex technical projects end to end, and mentoring engineers to a higher standard. AI-assisted development Hands-on experience with AI coding assistants such as Claude Code , Kiro , Codex , and GitHub Copilot , integrated effectively into day-to-day engineering. A genuine commitment to working within — and helping to shape — an AI-first development culture. AI and machine learning Practical understanding of modern Generative AI and Large Language Models (LLMs). Familiarity with open-source foundation models such as Llama, Mistral, Gemma, Qwen, or DeepSeek. Understanding of AI inference concepts, including model serving, latency, throughput, batching, performance improvements, optimizations, benchmarking of model inference?. Knowledge of model fine-tuning techniques, including supervised fine-tuning (SFT), LoRA, and parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT). Understanding of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), vector databases, embeddings, and semantic search. Experience integrating AI models into production applications using APIs or self-hosted inference platforms. AI platform and infrastructure Experience with containerised AI workloads on Docker and Kubernetes. Familiarity with AI serving frameworks such as vLLM, Triton Inference Server, TensorRT-LLM, or similar technologies. Understanding of GPU-accelerated computing and how AI workloads are deployed on modern GPU infrastructure. Experience deploying scalable AI applications in cloud or private cloud environments. 
 Nice to have Experience building AI/ML platforms or AI-enabled enterprise products. Advanced work with CRDs and operator patterns. Cloud platforms — AWS preferred; Azure or Google Cloud also welcome. Service mesh technologies and platform-engineering concepts. Observability stacks such as OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, or similar. Contributions to open-source projects. 
 How we'll measure success You'll know you're succeeding when you: Deliver scalable, reliable platform capabilities that accelerate RackAI innovation. Lift developer productivity through automation, platform improvements, and AI-augmented workflows. Influence architectural direction across the RackAI ecosystem. Drive measurable gains in platform performance, scalability, and reliability. Raise the engineering bar of the teams around you through mentorship and leadership. Keep a steady flow of innovation going, balanced with operational excellence.

title: Senior Principal Platform Engineer - QA
description:
Job Purpose 
 The Senior Principal Platform Engineer - QA will help shape and evolve the organisations quality engineering platform, enabling teams to build, test, deploy and operate software faster, more securely, and more reliably. The QA role will set the testing and quality standards helping to build test automation that can be adopted across platform and application teams. They will also mentor the engineers around them, and treats the teams who consume the test automation as customers. The role works through infrastructure-as-code and golden paths rather than manual configuration, uses AI-assisted engineering across code generation, review and testing, and engineers reliability in by defining SLOs, instrumenting for observability and automating away toil. Engineering roadmap and direction sit with the Engineering Director, reference architecture and standards sit with the Platform Architect, backlog order sits with the Product Owner, and deep reliability engineering sits with the Site Reliability Engineer deployed from Reliability Engineering Operations. 
 
 Key responsibilities 
 
 Quality strategy and architecture 
 Define the platform quality engineering strategy, test pyramid and quality gates for all cloud platform products. 
 
 Continuous verification and automation 
 Build shift-left quality into CI/CD: automated gates for security, compliance, cost and drift before merge and release. 
 
 GxP and computerised system assurance 
 Modernise qualification from document-heavy validation to risk-based, automated Assurance. 
 
 Images, supply chain and security quality 
 Own test frameworks for VM, OS, database and container image bakeries: CIS benchmarks, vulnerability thresholds, SBOM and signing checks. 
 
 AI and agentic platform quality 
 Define evaluation frameworks for platform AI agents: accuracy, safety guardrail. 
 
 Engineering leadership 
 Set quality metrics and SLOs, report them to platform and security leadership, and drive corrective actions. 
 
 Required experience and skills 
 15+ years in software or platform engineering, with 3+ years leading quality or test engineering for tenant platforms at enterprise scale. Deep hands-on Terraform experience Strong policy-as-code skills around OPA/Rego Production experience on Azure and GCP; working knowledge of Kubernetes and GitOps Built CI/CD quality gates in GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps or similar. Proficient in at least one of Python, Go or TypeScript for test frameworks and tooling. Experience in a regulated industry (life sciences, pharma, finance or healthcare), including GxP or equivalent validation. Track record of setting technical direction across multiple teams without direct authority. 
 
 Preferred qualifications 
 Experience testing LLM-based or agentic systems Familiarity with software supply chain standards: SLSA, SBOM (SPDX/CycloneDX), Sigstore/cosign. Chaos engineering tools such as Azure Chaos Studio, LitmusChaos or Gremlin. Experience with Red Hat Ansible Automation Platform, Azure Arc or hybrid estates. Certifications such as Azure Solutions Architect Expert, Google Professional Cloud Architect, ISTQB Advanced or CKA. 
 
 Leadership behaviours and ways of working 
 Quality as an engineering discipline: builds automation and paved roads, not manual sign-off queues. Risk-based judgement: scales testing rigour to patient, product and data-integrity impact. Influence without authority: aligns platform, security, Quality and GRC stakeholders on shared standards. Hands-on credibility: writes and reviews code, and can debug a failing pipeline alongside the team. Clear communicator: turns quality data into decisions for senior leadership and auditors alike.
