title: Technical Lead
description:
Job Description 
 Title: Tech Lead / Engineering Lead
 Experience: 8-10 years
 Location: Sector 55, Gurugram (On-site, 5 days)
 Industry: B2B SaaS / Enterprise Technology
 
 About Master-O: 
Master-O is a sales enablement platform used by leading enterprises across industries like FMCG, Pharma, Banking, Insurance, Automotive, Retail, Technology etc. to drive the capability development and frontline readiness for their customer-facing teams with the help of microlearning, game-based assessments and AI-powered conversational roleplays.
As we continue to expand our enterprise deployments across Pan India, North America, Middle East, and Southeast Asia, we are looking for a Tech Lead to take ownership of our engineering function and drive the successful delivery, implementation, and scalability of our solution.
 
 The Role: 
This is a high-ownership role for someone who enjoys building features, solving complex engineering problems, and collaborating with internal teams and customers. You will be leading a team of 5-6 developers and will be the face of the engineering function at Master-O.
Reporting directly to the Founder, this role requires someone who can balance engineering excellence with business priorities and ensure reliable delivery across multiple enterprise clients and geographies.
We are particularly interested in people who have prior worked in a growing SaaS organisation or have entrepreneurial experience and understand what it takes to build and deliver features from scratch.
 
 Key Responsibilities: 
 1. Engineering Leadership & Technical Ownership Own the engineering function, including architecture, development, code quality, performance, scalability, security, and maintenance. Lead a team of 5-6 engineers, providing technical direction, reviewing code, ensuring timely delivery and nurturing their career path. Remain hands-on with development and debugging rather than functioning solely as a people manager. Establish engineering standards, development practices, testing protocols, and release processes. Make pragmatic technology decisions that balance long-term scalability with ad-hoc business requirements. 
 2. Enterprise Implementations & Client Delivery Own the technical execution of our implementations with enterprise clients across the globe. Drive client-specific configurations, integrations, customizations, deployments, and production rollouts. Work closely with the Founder, Customer Success team, Product team, and other key stakeholders to translate client requirements into robust technical outcomes. Troubleshoot complex production issues, manage technical dependencies within team, and ensure implementation timelines and quality standards are met. Build reusable frameworks and integration capabilities that reduce implementation time and minimize repetitive custom development. 
 3. AI Engineering & Emerging Technologies Evaluate and implement AI capabilities that solve real enterprise problems and enhance product functionality. Experience integrating Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and AI agents into enterprise applications will be a strong advantage. Understand the practical considerations of deploying AI in production, including data security, reliability, latency, cost, and evaluation. Encourage responsible adoption of AI coding tools such as Claude Code while ensuring engineers retain strong fundamentals, understand the code they ship, and take ownership of its quality. 
 4. Team & Execution Management Take ownership of engineering priorities, sprint execution, resource allocation, and delivery commitments. Build a culture of accountability, ownership, collaboration, and continuous improvement. Ensure the team can independently diagnose and resolve technical problems rather than relying excessively on external tools or generated code. Collaborate with leadership to align engineering priorities with customer commitments, product roadmaps, and business objectives. 
 Required Technical Skills: 
 Strong hands-on experience with Node.js, Express.js, React, MySQL, Python, and AWS. Solid understanding of backend architecture, REST APIs, database design, system integrations, and cloud-based deployments. Experience building, maintaining, and scaling production-grade mobile and web applications. Strong debugging, code review, system design, and performance optimization skills. Familiarity with software development lifecycle practices, version control, automated testing, CI/CD, and production monitoring. Ability to make independent technical decisions and take ownership of issues from identification through resolution. 
 Experience & Qualifications: 
 8-10 years of relevant software engineering experience, with demonstrated progression into technical leadership. Prior experience leading a team of junior and mid-level engineers. Experience in a B2B SaaS company or an enterprise technology environment is strongly preferred. Experience managing enterprise client implementations, integrations, and production deployments. B.Tech / B.E. in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related engineering discipline, preferably from a Tier-1 engineering college. 
 What We Are Looking For: 
We are looking for a seasoned engineering professional who has experience handling multiple clients, varied integration requirements, competing priorities, and production issues.
You must be flexible to coordinate across time zones and work outside standard business hours when client implementations or critical releases require it.
This role offers the opportunity to work closely with the Founder, influence the product and architecture decisions, lead a compact engineering team, and directly shape how our technology scales across enterprise customers in not just domestic but international markets. 
If this sounds like you, please write to us at utkarshb@masteroapp.com or reach directly at 9068526176.

title: Senior Demand Planning Analyst / Consultant
description:
Role Summary Plan Optimus is looking for an experienced Demand Planning Analyst / Consultant with 4+ years of hands-on experience working with leading supply chain planning platforms such as Blue Yonder, o9 Solutions, or Kinaxis . The ideal candidate should have strong functional knowledge of demand forecasting, statistical forecasting, demand planning processes, and Integrated Business Planning (IBP). The candidate will work closely with our product development, implementation, and customer-facing teams to design, enhance, configure, and support the Plan Optimus Demand Planning solution. This role requires an individual who can independently understand business planning requirements, translate them into functional specifications, work with technical teams, and contribute to building a competitive enterprise demand planning platform. Key Responsibilities 1. Demand Planning Solution Design & Development Work with the Plan Optimus product development team to design and enhance demand planning capabilities. Translate business requirements into functional specifications, workflows, configuration requirements, and solution designs. Apply experience from Blue Yonder, o9, or Kinaxis to recommend industry-standard demand planning features and best practices. Define planning workflows, business rules, calculations, exceptions, and KPIs. Participate in solution testing, validation, and product enhancements. 2. Demand Forecasting & Analytics Support statistical forecasting, baseline forecasting, and demand forecasting processes. Understand forecasting methods, including moving averages, exponential smoothing, trend, seasonality, and machine learning-based forecasting. Analyze forecast accuracy, forecast bias, MAPE, WMAPE, and other demand planning KPIs. Support demand sensing, promotional planning, new product introductions, and product cannibalization analysis. Assist in developing exception-based planning and demand planning dashboards. 3. Demand Planning Configuration & Implementation Configure demand planning parameters, planning hierarchies, time buckets, and business rules. Support demand planning implementations, enhancements, and ongoing application support. Understand demand planning data requirements, including sales history, product hierarchies, customer hierarchies, promotional events, and external demand drivers. Collaborate with technical teams on data integration, validation, and planning calculations. Troubleshoot functional issues and recommend improvements. 4. Business Analysis & Customer Engagement Conduct requirement-gathering sessions with customers and business stakeholders. Understand existing demand planning processes and identify opportunities for improvement. Prepare functional requirement documents, solution design documents, test scenarios, and user acceptance testing plans. Conduct solution demonstrations, user training, and workshops. Work independently as a Demand Planning Subject Matter Expert (SME). 5. Product Development & Cross-Functional Collaboration Collaborate with software developers, data engineers, data scientists, and optimization specialists. Provide functional inputs for AI-enabled demand planning, scenario planning, and exception management. Work with Supply Planning, Inventory Planning, and S&OP teams to ensure integrated planning capabilities. Participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies, sprint planning, and product backlog prioritization. Mentor junior analysts and support knowledge sharing. Must-Have Skills 4+ years of experience in Demand Planning , including hands-on experience with at least one of the following:
 Blue Yonder Demand Planning o9 Solutions Demand Planning / Integrated Business Planning Kinaxis RapidResponse / Maestro Demand Planning Strong understanding of demand forecasting, statistical forecasting, and demand planning business processes. Experience configuring, implementing, enhancing, or supporting enterprise demand planning applications. Ability to translate business requirements into functional specifications and technical requirements. Experience with demand planning hierarchies, forecasting parameters, planning workflows, and exception management. Good understanding of forecast accuracy metrics, including MAPE, WMAPE, and forecast bias. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and troubleshooting skills. Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and working knowledge of SQL. Experience working with software development teams in Agile/Scrum environments. Strong communication, documentation, and stakeholder-management skills. Ability to work independently and take ownership of functional deliverables. Good-to-Have Skills Experience with Integrated Business Planning (IBP), Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP), Supply Planning, or Inventory Optimization. Experience in CPG, Food & Beverage, Retail, Quick Service Restaurants (QSR), or Distribution industries. Exposure to AI/ML-based demand forecasting and predictive analytics. Knowledge of Python, SQL, Snowflake, or modern data analytics platforms. Experience with promotional forecasting, demand sensing, new product forecasting, and cannibalization. Understanding of scenario planning, what-if analysis, and exception-based planning. Experience participating in product development for enterprise planning software. Experience conducting customer workshops, solution demonstrations, and user acceptance testing. Educational Qualifications Undergraduate: B.E. / B.Tech, B.Sc, B.Com, BBA, or equivalent qualification. Preferred: MBA in Operations / Supply Chain Management, Master's in Supply Chain Management, Industrial Engineering, or related disciplines. Ideal Candidate Profile We are particularly interested in candidates who have worked as Demand Planning Functional Consultants, Business Analysts, Solution Consultants, or Product Analysts on Blue Yonder, o9, or Kinaxis implementations. The candidate should have a strong understanding of how enterprise demand planning solutions work, including their business processes, configuration capabilities, planning workflows, and analytical features. This is primarily a functional and techno-functional role, not a pure software development position. Candidates should be comfortable collaborating with developers to translate supply chain planning requirements into software capabilities.

title: Full Stack Developer
description:
Please use the below link to apply for the position - https://forms.cloud.microsoft/r/D3yY12Kvh9?origin=lprLink Full Stack Engineer - Platform Apps & Developer Experience Role title: Full Stack Engineer Platform Applications & Developer Experience 
 Seniority: Senior Full Stack Engineer (hands-on build + operations, automation-first) 
 Platform: ChocoMake” (internal codename) — governed data mesh platform on Microsoft Fabric with Azure services, platform apps, and IaC automation 1) Context & Mission ChocoMake is Barry Callebaut’s enterprise data platform, designed to scale analytics, BI, and AI through a governed data mesh . It provisions standardized data product zones (Dev/Test/Prod) for decentralized Data Product Teams and provides shared services, guardrails, automation, monitoring, and a self-service experience through a Global Management Zone . A critical part of this platform is the platform application layer : the portal, documentation site, and supporting APIs/automation that expose platform inventory, onboarding information, environment visibility, and cost transparency. As a Full Stack Engineer, your mission is to build and operate ChocoMake’s platform-facing applications so that platform usage is intuitive, self-service, secure-by-default, and observable. You’ll work closely with Platform Engineers (IaC/blueprints) and Cloud Engineers (operations/SRE-style) to ensure that platform apps are: Secure (identity, least privilege, private networking) Reliable (monitoring, incident readiness) Automated (CI/CD, IaC-aligned deployment) Aligned with platform reality (pulling inventory from Terraform state and Azure resources) 2) What You Will Build & Operate (Core App/UX Scope) You will support both global shared components and per-platform application components, aligned to the platform’s architectural patterns. A. ChocoMake Portal (Core Internal Product) Full stack development for the ChocoMake Portal , including: Frontend UX for platform self-service views and inventory Backend APIs supporting portal features Data layer design and performance tuning Integration pattern: Terraform-state extraction SQL inventory portal views (platform inventory derived from IaC outputs/state). Runtime hosting: Azure App Service (including containerized deployment patterns) Azure SQL Database for portal persistence/inventory views Azure Container Registry for application images B. Documentation Site (Docs-as-Code) Build and operate the platform documentation site using: MkDocs (docs-as-code) Azure Static Web Apps hosting CI/CD pipelines that publish documentation reliably and securely C. APIs, Sidecars, and Automation Services Build services/sidecars that: Extract or interpret platform metadata (e.g., Terraform outputs/state, environment definitions) Populate portal SQL tables and platform inventory views Support self-service onboarding workflows and platform status visibility D. Observability & Cost Transparency Surfaces Contribute to “ChocoMake Insights” type experiences by: Integrating cost exports / cost reporting outputs into portal views Surfacing health/status signals (alerts, dashboards summaries) in a product-friendly way E. Security & Networking Constraints You Must Respect Platforms patterns include: Private endpoints , private DNS zones , and disabling public network access via IaC/variables Key Vault with private endpoints and secret lifecycle Entra ID / RBAC group patterns and least privilege Your applications must function correctly in private networking contexts and support secure identity flows. 3) Key Responsibilities A. Build Product-Grade Platform Applications Deliver high-quality frontend and backend features for the ChocoMake Portal. Design APIs and services with clean contracts and good performance. Implement robust data models and query patterns in Azure SQL DB to support inventory and reporting needs. B. Operate What You Build (DevOps + SRE Discipline) Own production readiness for platform apps: Monitoring, alerting, logging, dashboards Incident response participation, RCA contributions, and remediation Maintain availability and reliability for platform apps across Dev/Test/Prod. C. Automation-First Delivery (CI/CD) Maintain Azure DevOps pipelines for: Container build/push (ACR) App Service releases (including webhook/continuous deployment patterns where applicable) Static Web Apps publication for docs (MkDocs) Ensure versioned releases, rollback strategies, and safe config management. D. Secure-by-Default Engineering Implement identity and access patterns aligned with platform standards: Entra ID groups and RBAC Managed identities where appropriate Secrets via Key Vault (never in code/pipelines) Ensure compliance with private endpoint/DNS patterns (no “works only on public internet” shortcuts). E. Platform Alignment and Cross-Team Enablement Work with Platform Engineers to ensure the portal reflects the actual IaC truth (inventories, environments, standards). Work with Cloud Engineers to align operational monitoring, alerts, and incident handling. Create documentation and developer guidance to reduce support load and accelerate adoption. 4) Must-Have Technical Skills (Selection Criteria) Full Stack Engineering (Senior Level) Strong experience delivering modern web applications end-to-end: Frontend: React/TypeScript (or equivalent enterprise-grade SPA stack) Backend: Node.js/.NET/Java (any is acceptable if you demonstrate strong API engineering) API design discipline (REST, auth, pagination, error models, idempotency). Azure Application Hosting & Cloud Operations Hands-on experience with: Azure App Service (including containerized deployments) Azure Container Registry Azure Static Web Apps Azure SQL Database Comfortable troubleshooting real production issues (latency, connectivity, auth, DNS/private endpoints). DevOps & Automation Azure DevOps pipelines (build/release), Git workflows, PR reviews. Container build and deployment pipelines. Comfort working in IaC-driven environments (understanding Terraform outputs/state usage even if not a primary Terraform author). Security Foundations Entra ID concepts (app registrations/service principals), RBAC, managed identities. Secure secrets management with Key Vault. Strong awareness of private networking implications (private endpoints, private DNS). Observability Azure Monitor + Log Analytics fundamentals, structured logging, alert tuning. 5) Strong Advantages (Nice-to-Have) Experience building internal developer platforms or self-service portals that integrate with IaC inventories. Familiarity with data platform concepts (Fabric workspaces/capacities, OneLake, ADF) to better present platform status and inventory. Experience in cost transparency UX (tagging, cost exports, chargeback views). Experience building secure apps in “no public endpoint” enterprise environments. 6) Ways of Working & Expectations You work in an engineering-first, automation-first culture: PR-based changes, repeatable deployments, clear ownership. You care about operability as much as features: if it can’t be monitored and supported, it’s not done. You collaborate effectively across platform engineering, cloud operations, and data product teams to keep the platform experience coherent and trustworthy. 7) Deliverables You’ll Be Accountable For (First 6–12 Months) Improved ChocoMake Portal capabilities (inventory accuracy, onboarding UX, platform insights). Stable CI/CD pipelines for portal, APIs, and docs-as-code. Hardened security posture for platform apps (Key Vault, MI, RBAC alignment, private networking). Improved observability: dashboards, alerts, and runbooks that reduce MTTR for platform-app incidents. 8) Interview Focus Areas (How We Will Assess Fit) System design: design a portal feature that reads platform inventory from IaC outputs/state and serves it reliably. Azure operations scenario: diagnose a production issue involving private endpoints/private DNS and App Service connectivity. CI/CD: propose a pipeline approach for container build/push + App Service release + rollback. Security: identity model choice (service principal vs managed identity), Key Vault integration, least privilege. Quality: testing strategy, API error contracts, performance approach for Azure SQL queries.

Key Skills: Azure,React Js,SQL,.Net,Python,Full Stack,Microsoft Azure,Development

description:
WE'RE HIRING! Psychologists Freshers & Experienced | 100% Work From Home 
 MindTribe Healthcare Pvt. Ltd. Founded by Dr. Prerna Kohli, renowned Clinical Psychologist, four-time Gold Medalist, and recipient of a prestigious national honour from the President of India. 
 Job Title: Psychologist / Counselling Psychologist / Clinical Psychologist
 Experience: 015 Years | Freshers Strongly Encouraged to Apply
 Qualification: MA / MSc Psychology (Minimum) | M.Phil. & Ph.D. Welcome
 Job Location: PAN India
 Work Mode: 100% Remote / Work From Home
 Employment Type: FULL-TIME ONLY
 Company Website: www.mindtribe.in 
 Your Career in Psychology Starts Here! 
 Are you a psychology postgraduate dreaming of building a successful career in counselling and private practice? 
 Have you recently completed your master's degree in psychology but are struggling to find the right opportunity because everyone wants experience? 
 Or are you an experienced psychologist looking for a fresh start, professional growth, and the convenience of working from home? MindTribe wants to hear from YOU! 
 We are expanding our team of psychologists across India and are looking for passionate, empathetic, enthusiastic, and career-oriented individuals to join us. 
 At MindTribe, we believe that every great psychologist deserves an opportunity to grow, develop professionally, and make a meaningful difference in people's lives. 
 FRESHERS ARE WELCOME! ZERO YEARS OF EXPERIENCE IS NOT A DISQUALIFICATION! 
 If you have the right educational qualifications, a passion for mental health, and the determination to build a rewarding career, we encourage you to apply. 
 About MindTribe MindTribe Healthcare Pvt. Ltd. is a mental healthcare organisation founded by Dr. Prerna Kohli , one of India's distinguished clinical psychologists, with over three decades of experience in mental healthcare. 
 MindTribe is committed to making professional psychological support accessible through technology, compassionate care, and qualified mental health professionals. 
 Our mission is to create an environment where psychologists can develop their professional capabilities while helping individuals navigate emotional, behavioural, and psychological challenges. 
 Join an organisation built around psychology, led by people who understand psychology, and dedicated to advancing mental healthcare. 
 Roles & Responsibilities As a Psychologist at MindTribe, your responsibilities will include: Conducting online psychological counselling and support sessions with clients, as appropriate to your qualifications, training, and professional scope of practice. Understanding clients' emotional, behavioural, interpersonal, and mental health concerns. Building professional, empathetic, and supportive therapeutic relationships with clients. Using appropriate evidence-based psychological techniques and interventions. Developing individualised counselling and support plans based on client requirements. Monitoring client progress and maintaining professional documentation. Maintaining strict confidentiality and following ethical guidelines. Identifying situations requiring specialist intervention, supervision, or referral. Participating in case discussions, team meetings, training, and professional development activities. Collaborating with senior psychologists and other mental health professionals when required. Following MindTribe's clinical protocols, professional standards, and organisational policies. Continuously developing professional knowledge and counselling skills. 
 Freshers will be considered for responsibilities appropriate to their qualifications, competencies, and supervision requirements. 
 Who Can Apply? 
 1. Fresh Psychology Postgraduates (0 Years' Experience) Have you recently completed your MA or MSc in Psychology? Are you passionate about counselling, therapy, emotional wellness, and understanding human behaviour? 
 Do you want to turn your academic knowledge into a meaningful professional career? 
 Then this opportunity is for YOU! We welcome applications from freshers who: Hold a master's degree in psychology or a relevant specialisation. Have a genuine interest in counselling and mental healthcare. Possess strong listening, communication, and interpersonal skills. Are motivated to learn and develop professionally. Want to build a long-term career in psychology or private practice. Are willing to work full-time from home. Demonstrate professionalism, empathy, and commitment. 
 Previous employment experience is NOT mandatory. 
 2. Experienced Psychologists (115+ Years) We also welcome applications from experienced professionals who: Have experience in psychological counselling, therapy, or mental healthcare. Are seeking new professional opportunities and long-term career growth. Want to transition from traditional workplace settings to a remote working environment. Have experience handling clients independently within their professional scope. Possess strong ethical standards and professional communication skills. Are passionate about delivering quality mental healthcare. Educational Qualifications 
 Mandatory Minimum Qualification: MA / MSc in Psychology MA / MSc in Counselling Psychology MA / MSc in Applied Psychology MA / MSc in Clinical Psychology Equivalent recognised postgraduate qualifications in relevant psychology disciplines 
 Higher Qualifications Are Welcome: M.Phil. in Clinical Psychology Ph.D. in Psychology Additional recognised training in counselling and psychotherapy 
 Candidates applying for positions requiring professional registration must hold the applicable registration and qualifications. 
 Work-From-Home Requirements This is a 100% REMOTE, FULL-TIME POSITION . Candidates must have: A reliable, high-speed broadband internet connection. A personal laptop or desktop computer. A functional webcam, microphone, and headset. A quiet, private, distraction-free workspace. An environment suitable for maintaining complete client confidentiality. Basic computer skills and comfort using online meeting platforms. The ability to maintain professional schedules and attend appointments punctually. The discipline and commitment required for full-time remote employment. 
 You can apply from anywhere in India. Relocation is not required! 
 The Ideal MindTribe Psychologist 
 We're looking for more than academic qualifications. We'd love to meet candidates who are: Passionate about psychology and mental health. Compassionate, patient, understanding, and non-judgmental. Excellent communicators and attentive listeners. Eager to learn and improve their professional skills. Committed to helping people achieve emotional well-being. Professional, responsible, and ethically grounded. Comfortable working in an online mental healthcare environment. Motivated to build a meaningful, long-term career. Fluent in English and/or Hindi; additional regional languages are an advantage. 
 Most importantly, we value a positive attitude, willingness to learn, and genuine passion for psychology. 
 Perks, Benefits & Career Opportunities 
 Why should you choose MindTribe? 
 100% Work From Home 
Build your career from the comfort of your home, without the daily commute or the need to relocate. An Opportunity for Freshers 
Begin your professional journey with an organisation dedicated to psychology and mental healthcare. Exposure to Online Private Practice 
Understand the professional processes, responsibilities, and practical aspects of delivering psychological services online. Career Growth & Development 
Opportunities to strengthen your professional abilities, gain relevant experience, and progress in your career. Professional Collaboration 
Work as part of a team of psychology and mental healthcare professionals. Performance-Based Incentives 
Eligibility for additional performance-linked incentives, subject to company policy. Performance Bonuses & Recognition 
Opportunities for recognition and rewards based on professional contributions and applicable policies. Leave Benefits 
Leave entitlements in accordance with company policies. No Daily Commute 
Save valuable time and commuting expenses while working remotely. Meaningful Professional Experience 
Build your career while contributing to the emotional and psychological well-being of others. Purpose-Driven Work 
Be part of a mission to make professional mental healthcare more accessible. 
 Why Freshers Should Apply 
 Your master's degree is an achievement. Your career deserves a great beginning. We understand that entering the professional world after completing an MA or MSc in Psychology can feel challenging. You have the knowledge. You have the passion. You have spent years studying human behaviour, emotions, mental health, and psychological well-being.

title: Senior Cloud Network & Security Engineer - GCP / Palo Alto
description:
Job Title: Senior Cloud Network Security Engineer - GCP / Palo Alto Location: Hyderabad Department: IT (On-Prem)and Cloud Infra Managed Services Delivery Experience: 10+ years 
 
 Job Summary 
 We are looking for a Senior Cloud Network Security Engineer with 10+ years of overall experience in network engineering, cloud networking, and security. The candidate should have strong hands-on experience with GCP networking, GKE networking, Palo Alto Networks firewalls/VM-Series, VPN, Cloudflare, cloud gateways, automation, and hybrid connectivity. The role will be responsible for designing, implementing, securing, troubleshooting, and maintaining highly available cloud network infrastructure and security solutions. 
 
 Key Responsibilities 
 
 GCP GKE Networking 
 Design, implement, and manage GCP network infrastructure, including VPC, Shared VPC, subnets, routing, Cloud Router, Cloud NAT, Cloud VPN, VPC Peering, Private Service Connect, and Load Balancing. Strong hands-on experience with GKE networking, including VPC-native clusters, Pod/Service networking, Alias IPs, Network Policies, Ingress, DNS, firewall rules, Private GKE, and GKE connectivity. Troubleshoot GCP/GKE connectivity, routing, DNS, ingress/egress, and performance issues. Design secure connectivity between GCP, GKE, on-premises, and other cloud environments. 
 
 Palo Alto Networks 
 Design, deploy, configure, and manage Palo Alto VM-Series firewalls on GCP. Manage firewall policies, NAT, routing, security zones, application controls, threat prevention, URL filtering, and logging. Design and manage Primary/Secondary or Active-Passive Palo Alto HA configurations, including synchronization and failover. Configure and troubleshoot IPsec Site-to-Site VPN and GlobalProtect VPN. Manage Palo Alto PAN-OS upgrades/updates, licensing, subscriptions, configuration backup/restore, and license-related issues. Perform firewall rule optimization, troubleshooting, and security monitoring. 
 
 Cloudflare Cloud Gateway 
 Manage Cloudflare DNS, WAF, CDN, DDoS protection, SSL/TLS, Zero Trust, and traffic management. Design and manage secure cloud gateway / internet gateway architectures, including ingress/egress traffic, NAT, routing, and centralized security inspection. Integrate Cloudflare, Palo Alto, GCP Load Balancing, and application environments. 
 
 Cloud Security 
 Implement network security, segmentation, IAM, Zero Trust, encryption, firewall controls, and secure ingress/egress. Collaborate with Security and DevSecOps teams to implement security best practices and controls. Support security incidents, root-cause analysis, and remediation activities. 
 
 Automation Operations 
 Automate infrastructure using Terraform, Ansible, and GitOps practices. Develop automation/scripts using Python, Bash, or PowerShell. Use Datadog and GCP/Palo Alto monitoring and logging for performance monitoring and troubleshooting. Maintain architecture diagrams, configuration standards, and operational documentation. Provide technical guidance and collaborate with Cloud, DevOps, Security, and Development teams. 
 
 Required Skills Experience 
 10+ years of overall experience in Network Engineering, Cloud Networking, Infrastructure, or Cloud Security. 5+ years of hands-on GCP networking experience. Strong hands-on experience with GKE networking, architecture, operations, and troubleshooting. Strong experience with Palo Alto Networks firewalls, preferably VM-Series on GCP. Experience with Palo Alto Primary/Secondary or Active-Passive HA. Strong experience with Palo Alto firewall policies, NAT, routing, security zones, and security profiles. Hands-on experience with IPsec VPN and GlobalProtect. Experience with Palo Alto licensing, subscriptions, PAN-OS upgrades/updates, and troubleshooting. Hands-on experience with Cloudflare DNS, WAF, CDN, DDoS, SSL/TLS, and Zero Trust. Strong knowledge of TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, BGP, OSPF, IPsec, and HTTP/HTTPS. Experience with Terraform/IaC, Ansible, GitOps, and CI/CD. Scripting experience in Python, Bash, or PowerShell. Experience with Datadog and cloud monitoring/logging. Strong understanding of cloud security, network segmentation, IAM, Zero Trust, and DevSecOps. Experience with hybrid cloud and on-premises connectivity. 
 
 Qualifications 
 Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field. Strong communication, analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills. Ability to work independently and provide technical leadership to engineering teams. 
 
 Preferred Certifications 
 Google Cloud Professional Cloud Network Engineer Google Cloud Professional Cloud Architect Palo Alto PCNSA / PCNSE or equivalent hands-on expertise. 
 
 Key Technology Stack 
 GCP GKE Palo Alto VM-Series PAN-OS GlobalProtect Cloudflare VPN VPC Cloud Router Cloud NAT Load Balancing Terraform Ansible GitOps Datadog Python/Bash DevSecOps 
 
 Ideal Candidate 
 A 10+ year senior cloud network/security professional with strong hands-on expertise in GCP + GKE Networking + Palo Alto VM-Series + Palo Alto HA + VPN + Cloudflare + Cloud Gateway + Security + Terraform, capable of independently handling enterprise cloud networking, security architecture, production troubleshooting, and automation.

title: Senior Devops Engineer
description:
About the role We are hiring a Senior DevOps Engineer to own and evolve the deployment of our AI-powered application modernization platform (NEXUS) into client production environments. This role is a unique hybrid of Platform Engineering and Technical Advisory. You will not only design the underlying multi-cloud infrastructure (AWS, Azure, GCP) but also partner directly with client IT groups to establish SysOps frameworks. You will leverage our AI-driven automation tools to provision infrastructure, integrate AIOps for anomaly detection and remediation, and ensure clients receive seamless product updates via our Helm-based delivery pipeline. This is a senior individual contributor role that requires a "product mindset"you are designing for scale, security, and long-term operational sustainability in client environments. What you will do Client Collaboration & SysOps Partnership Serve as the primary technical partner to client IT groups, guiding them on best practices for operating bespoke NEXUS implementations. Work with client-aligned delivery teams to manage the lifecycle of the platform, ensuring timely and reliable product updates via Helm charts. Collaborate with client stakeholders to tailor infrastructure and operational workflows, ensuring NEXUS integrates seamlessly with their existing enterprise monitoring and ticketing systems. AI-Driven Automation & AIOps Integration Build & Leverage AI for Provisioning: Architect and implement AI-assisted workflows to automate the provisioning and configuration of infrastructure across multi-cloud environments. AIOps Implementation: Integrate and adopt 3Pillar’s AIOps platform into client ecosystems to enable proactive, automated anomaly detection and incident remediation. Knowledge Base Evolution: Maintain and refine the AIOps knowledge base, training agents to perform accurate root-cause analysis (RCA) and automate recurring issue resolution.1 Platform & Multi-Cloud Development Evolve our Helm-based platform layer and Terraform module libraries to support standardized, secure deployment patterns across AWS, Azure, and GCP.12 Design for "Delegation": Move our automation from simple execution to self-adapting workflows that handle ambiguity and get smarter over time.3 Ensure all infrastructure-as-code and automated remediation scripts meet rigorous enterprise security and compliance standards, including PII access logging and least-privilege IAM. Our technology stack You should be comfortable working with most of the following (or able to ramp quickly): Area Technologies IaC Terraform (>= 1.5), remote state (S3 + DynamoDB), module versioning via Git tags Cloud AWS (primary for client deployments): EKS, VPC, NLB, EFS, ECR, Route 53, KMS, IAM/IRSA • Azure: AKS, Key Vault, ACR, VNet • GCP: GKE, Artifact Registry Kubernetes Production cluster operations, storage classes, ingress, HPA, troubleshooting CrashLoop / init failures Packaging Helm (umbrella charts, atomic releases), feature-flag-driven deployments Platform services HashiCorp Vault, Keycloak, OAuth2 Proxy, cert-manager, Zalando Postgres Operator, Neo4j, Redis Operator, Strimzi Kafka, Prometheus/Grafana/Loki, Apache Airflow, MinIO Application platform Python/FastAPI backend, React frontend, MCP server, background workers, retrieval/RAG services; container images on a private registry (e.g. GHCR) CI/CD & GitOps GitHub Actions, Flux (internal environments), image signing (Cosign) Observability & ops kubectl, helm, structured logging (Loki), metrics/alerts, operational runbooks Security TLS (Let's Encrypt DNS-01), secrets via Vault/VSO, SSO/OIDC, VPN / CIDR-based ingress controls Required experience Client-Facing Advisory & Enablement: Proven experience in a technical advisory or client-facing engineering role. You are comfortable partnering with client IT teams, guiding them through technical adoption, and translating complex platform requirements into operational success. DevOps & Infrastructure Expertise: 5+ years in DevOps, SRE, or Platform Engineering. You possess production-grade Terraform experience—architecting modular, multi-cloud IaC frameworks that enable consistent, repeatable deployments across different environments. AIOps & Observability: Hands-on experience integrating or managing AIOps platforms or automated observability stacks. You understand the lifecycle of incident response, anomaly detection, and automated remediation. AI-Driven Automation: Demonstrated experience building automation workflows. You don’t just write scripts; you build systems that reduce manual operational toil and empower users through self-service provisioning and automated configuration. Platform Engineering at Scale: Deep expertise in Kubernetes and Helm. You have a track record of deploying and operating complex, multi-service platforms and managing their lifecycle (chart development, values layering, atomic releases). Foundational Cloud Operations: Proven AWS expertise (EKS, networking, IAM/IRSA) with a strong aptitude for multi-cloud environments (Azure/GCP). Identity & Security: Solid experience with secrets management (HashiCorp Vault or similar) and identity/SSO integration (Keycloak/OIDC). Communication & Mentorship: Excellent written and verbal communication. You are able to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders and mentor teams on best practices. Strongly preferred / nice to have Consultative Experience: Prior work as a Solutions Architect, Technical Account Manager, or Implementation Engineer in a SaaS or Managed Services environment. AI/LLM Infrastructure: Experience managing infrastructure for AI/ML workloads, including GPU node pools, vector databases (e.g., Neo4j), or RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) pipelines. GitOps & Lifecycle: Hands-on experience with GitOps methodologies (Flux, Argo CD) for managing continuous deployment at scale. Enterprise Compliance: Experience operating within regulated or enterprise environments (PII logging, audit trails, network isolation, SOC2/compliance-heavy workflows). Kafka & Distributed Systems: Experience with event streaming platforms (e.g., Strimzi/Kafka) or specialized operators for stateful services. What success looks like in your first 6–12 months Successful enablement of client IT teams to independently manage and operate the NEXUS platform. Quantifiable reduction in manual operational toil for clients through the successful adoption of AIOps-driven anomaly detection and automated remediation. Seamless, low-friction delivery of platform updates via automated Helm-based pipelines. Deployment of robust, AI-provisioned infrastructure stacks that adapt to client-specific demands while maintaining security and compliance.

title: Java Technical Lead
description:
Role Overview 
 We are looking for an experienced Technical Lead with strong expertise in Java, Spring Boot, Microservices architecture, and Cloud technologies to lead the design, development, and delivery of scalable, secure, and high-performance banking applications. The ideal candidate will have a strong engineering background, proven experience leading development teams, and a solid understanding of banking business processes. The candidate must be capable of translating complex business requirements into robust technical solutions while maintaining high standards of code quality, security, performance, and engineering excellence. Candidates with experience in core banking, digital banking, payments, lending, banking integrations, or financial transaction processing will be preferred. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 1. Technical Leadership & Solution Design Lead end-to-end design, development, testing, and deployment of enterprise-grade banking applications. Define technical solutions, application architecture, service boundaries, and integration patterns. Drive microservices design principles, reusable components, coding standards, and engineering best practices. Participate in architecture reviews and collaborate with solution architects, enterprise architects, and business stakeholders. Identify technical risks, dependencies, performance bottlenecks, and opportunities for modernization. 
 2. Java & Spring Boot Development Provide hands-on technical leadership in Core Java, Spring Boot, and Spring-based application development. Design and develop RESTful APIs, backend services, and distributed applications. Apply object-oriented design principles, SOLID principles, design patterns, and clean coding practices. Implement secure, maintainable, testable, and highly available application components. Conduct code reviews, troubleshoot complex defects, and guide developers in resolving technical challenges. 
 3. Microservices & Distributed Systems Design and implement scalable, loosely coupled microservices architectures. Apply service discovery, API gateway, centralized configuration, circuit breakers, retries, timeouts, and fault-tolerance patterns. Design synchronous and asynchronous integrations using REST APIs and messaging platforms. Implement event-driven architecture using Apache Kafka or equivalent messaging technologies. Address distributed transactions, idempotency, data consistency, concurrency, and resiliency requirements. 
 4. Cloud & DevOps Engineering Design, deploy, and operate cloud-native applications on AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform. Implement containerized applications using Docker and Kubernetes or OpenShift. Collaborate with DevOps teams to establish CI/CD pipelines, automated deployments, and release management practices. Implement application monitoring, logging, tracing, alerting, and production observability. Contribute to cloud migration, application modernization, scalability, availability, and cost optimization. 
 5. Banking Domain & Application Integration Understand banking business processes and translate functional requirements into technical solutions. Work on banking applications involving payments, fund transfers, customer onboarding, account services, lending, transaction processing, or regulatory integrations. Ensure secure processing of financial transactions, data integrity, auditability, and appropriate access controls. Integrate with core banking systems, payment platforms, third-party services, and enterprise applications. Follow applicable security, risk, compliance, and data-protection requirements. 
 6. Team Management & Delivery Excellence Lead, mentor, and guide a team of Java developers and software engineers. Review technical designs, estimates, sprint plans, and delivery commitments. Collaborate with product owners, business analysts, architects, QA, security, and DevOps teams. Ensure adherence to development standards, automated testing, code quality, and release readiness. Take ownership of complex production issues, root-cause analysis, and preventive actions. Promote continuous improvement, technical knowledge sharing, and engineering capability development. 
 Mandatory Technical Skills 
 Core Technology Stack Strong hands-on experience in Core Java, preferably Java 17 or above. Extensive experience with Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Spring Security, Spring Data JPA, and Hibernate. Strong understanding of microservices architecture and distributed systems. Experience designing and developing REST APIs and enterprise integrations. Proficiency in SQL and relational databases such as Oracle, PostgreSQL, or MySQL. Hands-on experience with at least one major cloud platform: AWS, Azure, or GCP. Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines. Strong understanding of multithreading, concurrency, JVM performance, exception handling, and memory management. Experience with Git, Maven or Gradle, and automated testing using JUnit and Mockito. 
 Preferred Technical Skills Apache Kafka, RabbitMQ, or equivalent messaging technologies. Redis or other distributed caching technologies. NoSQL databases such as MongoDB or Cassandra. API management, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, JWT, and secure API design. Observability tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, Splunk, or OpenTelemetry. Infrastructure as Code using Terraform or equivalent tools. Cloud-native architecture, DevSecOps, and automated security testing. Knowledge of microservices patterns such as Saga, CQRS, and event-driven architecture. 
 Banking Domain Experience Candidates should preferably have experience in one or more of the following areas: Core Banking Systems Digital Banking and Omnichannel Banking Payments, UPI, NEFT, RTGS, IMPS, or card processing Retail Banking and Corporate Banking Lending, Loan Origination, or Loan Management Systems Customer Onboarding, KYC, and Customer 360 Banking API Integration and Open Banking Transaction Processing and Reconciliation Banking domain experience is strongly preferred. Candidates from fintech or other regulated financial services environments may also be considered if they demonstrate strong transaction-processing and security experience. 
 Education & Experience Bachelor's or master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline. 812 years of overall software development experience. At least 2–3 years in a Technical Lead or equivalent technical leadership role. Proven experience designing, developing, and deploying production-grade microservices. Demonstrated ability to remain hands-on while leading a team. Strong communication, problem-solving, stakeholder-management, and mentoring skills. 
 Key Success Criteria The successful candidate will be expected to: 1. Deliver scalable, secure, and high-quality banking applications. 2. Establish consistent engineering practices across the development team. 3. Improve application performance, reliability, maintainability, and production stability. 4. Ensure timely delivery of technical commitments with minimal production defects. 5. Build team capability in Java, Spring Boot, microservices, and cloud-native engineering. 6. Drive reusable solutions and alignment with the overall banking technology architecture.

Align alert routing with support ownership, severity model, runbooks and 24x7 support operating procedures. Drive improvements in alert hygiene, incident response discipline, on-call effectiveness and stakeholder notification flows. Use Power Automate to build workflows for notifications, approvals, SharePoint/Teams updates, scheduled checks, exception handling and operational governance. Use Power BI to create operational dashboards for incident trends, alert hygiene, SLA/SLO performance, capacity utilization, automation coverage, toil reduction and management reporting. Validate application behavior during infrastructure unavailability, degraded conditions, data center flips and recovery scenarios.  We are hiring a System Engineer (level: System Engineer or Sr. System Engineer based on experience) to join Cornerstone's Workforce AI team in Hyderabad. You will work on platform-level feature development, data integrations, and end-to-end observability - building the cloud platform and frameworks that AI product teams across Cornerstone depend on every day. Build and upgrade cloud environments for new clients, including application integration and migration-related infrastructure. Experience administering and troubleshooting Linux and Windows Server environments. Strong experience with monitoring, logging, metrics, dashboards, alerting and application/infrastructure observability. Strong communication and collaboration skills across engineering, architecture, security and operations teams. Experience with incident-management and IT service-management processes, including incident, change, problem and request management. Experience with reliability testing, disaster-recovery exercises, resilience automation and performance engineering. Cloud Support Engineer 
 
 Job Summary 
 We are looking for a skilled Azure Cloud Engineer with 3-5 years of experience in designing, implementing, managing, and optimizing Microsoft Azure cloud infrastructure. The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience with Azure services, cloud security, networking, monitoring, automation, and troubleshooting. The candidate will work closely with development, DevOps, and infrastructure teams to ensure secure, scalable, reliable, and cost-effective cloud environments.

 Design, deploy, configure, and manage Azure cloud infrastructure, including Virtual Machines, Virtual Networks, Storage Accounts, Azure App Services, and related services. Manage Azure networking components such as VNets, subnets, Network Security Groups (NSGs), Azure Load Balancer, Application Gateway, VPN Gateway, and DNS. Implement and maintain cloud security best practices, including Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), Microsoft Entra ID, Managed Identities, Key Vault, and access policies. Monitor cloud infrastructure performance, availability, and resource utilization using Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, and Application Insights. Automate infrastructure provisioning and routine operational tasks using Azure CLI, PowerShell, Azure Automation, and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools such as Terraform or ARM/Bicep templates. Support the implementation and maintenance of CI/CD pipelines in collaboration with DevOps teams using Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions. Manage backup, disaster recovery, business continuity, and high-availability configurations using appropriate Azure services. Troubleshoot cloud infrastructure issues, identify root causes, and implement corrective and preventive actions to minimize service disruptions. Optimize Azure resource utilization and cloud expenditure by implementing cost-monitoring, resource-tagging, and cost-optimization practices. Maintain technical documentation, architecture diagrams, configuration records, and operational procedures. Collaborate with development, security, DevOps, and infrastructure teams to support application deployments, cloud migrations, and environment management. Follow organizational policies and industry best practices for cloud governance, security, and operational management.

Good understanding of core Azure services, including Azure Virtual Machines, Virtual Networks, Storage Accounts, Azure App Services, and Azure Monitor. Practical experience with Azure networking, identity and access management, security configurations, and troubleshooting. Knowledge of scripting and automation using PowerShell, Azure CLI, or similar tools. Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, ARM templates, or Bicep). The role will be responsible for payroll accuracy, data integrity, reconciliations, compliance, employee records, and coordination with internal teams and payroll vendors.

Strong attention to detail and accuracy when processing complex payroll scenarios across different jurisdictions. title: Project Leader
description:
Job Title: Snowflake Developer (Data Lake Program with Snowflake Cortex) Role Overview The Snowflake Developer is responsible for building and optimizing data pipelines and analytical datasets within a Snowflake-based data lakehouse. This role also includes leveraging Snowflake Cortex to enable AI-driven data transformations, natural language processing, and intelligent data applications directly within the data platform. Key Responsibilities 1. Data Ingestion Integration Develop and maintain scalable data ingestion pipelines (batch and near real-time). Load data from databases, APIs, files, and streaming systems into Snowflake. Handle structured and semi-structured data (JSON, Parquet, Avro, CSV). Integrate Snowflake with cloud storage platforms (S3, Azure Data Lake, GCS). 2. Data Transformation (ELT) Build ELT pipelines using Snowflake SQL and native features (Streams, Tasks, Dynamic Tables). Implement transformations across Bronze, Silver, and Gold layers. Use tools like dbt for modular, reusable, and testable transformations. 3. Snowflake Cortex AI Enablement Leverage Snowflake Cortex functions within SQL for AI-powered transformations. Implement use cases such as: Text summarization of large datasets (logs, documents) Sentiment analysis and classification Natural language enrichment of datasets Work with vector embeddings and similarity search for semantic use cases. Assist in building AI-ready datasets for downstream analytics and ML. Collaborate with data scientists to integrate AI/ML logic into Snowflake pipelines. Support simple prompt engineering within Cortex functions for optimized outputs. 4. Data Modeling Design and implement analytical data models (star schema, snowflake schema). Build fact and dimension tables optimized for BI and AI use cases. Ensure datasets are structured for both analytics and AI consumption. 5. Performance Cost Optimization Optimize SQL queries and Snowflake workloads. Use clustering, caching, and efficient compute strategies. Monitor warehouse usage and control costs, including Cortex consumption. 6. Data Quality Validation Implement data validation checks and quality frameworks. Ensure accuracy, completeness, and consistency of data. Debug and resolve pipeline and data issues. 7. Security Governance Apply RBAC, masking policies, and row-level security. Ensure compliance with data governance and privacy standards. Maintain proper documentation and lineage for datasets. 8. Collaboration Agile Delivery Work with architects, analysts, and AI/ML teams. Translate business and AI use cases into technical implementations. Participate in Agile development processes. Required Skills Qualifications Core Snowflake Skills Strong hands-on experience with Snowflake. Advanced SQL skills with performance tuning. Experience with Snowflake features: Streams, Tasks, Dynamic Tables Time Travel, Zero-Copy Cloning Snowflake Cortex AI Skills Basic to intermediate experience with Snowflake Cortex functions. Understanding of: Generative AI concepts (LLMs, embeddings) Text processing and NLP basics Familiarity with: Prompt engineering techniques Semantic search and vector similarity concepts Data Engineering Skills Experience with ELT/ETL tools (dbt, Airflow, Informatica). Knowledge of cloud platforms (AWS / Azure / GCP). Familiarity with data lake/lakehouse architecture. Programming Tools Proficiency in SQL and working knowledge of Python. Experience with Git and CI/CD pipelines. Soft Skills Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities. Good communication and collaboration skills. Willingness to learn and adapt to AI-driven data technologies. Preferred Qualifications Snowflake certification (SnowPro Core). Experience working on AI-enabled data platforms. Exposure to vector databases or RAG architectures. Familiarity with BI tools (Power BI, Tableau, Looker). Understanding of DataOps / MLOps practices. Key Deliverables Scalable and reliable data pipelines. AI-enriched datasets using Snowflake Cortex. Optimized queries and cost-efficient workloads. High-quality, analytics- and AI-ready data models. Success Metrics Pipeline reliability and performance. Adoption of AI-powered data transformations. Query efficiency and cost optimization (including Cortex usage). Data quality and stakeholder satisfaction.

 The Advanced Manufacturing, Mobility Infrastructure (AMI) Industry Market contains the following industries: Aerospace and Defence, Chemicals, Infrastructure, Industrial Products, Automotive, and Transportation that includes Mobility-as-a-Service.  Enriching Lives Winning as ONE

Aditya Birla Capital Limited ("ABCL") is the holding company for the financial services businesses of the Aditya Birla Group. With subsidiaries/JVs that have a strong presence across Protecting, Investing and Financing solutions, ABCL is a financial solutions group that caters to the diverse needs of its customers across their life cycle.  Aditya Birla Finance Limited: 
Aditya Birla Finance Limited (ABFL), a subsidiary of Aditya Birla Capital Limited, is among the leading well-diversified non-banking financial services company in India. ABFL offers customized solutions in the areas of personal finance, mortgage finance, SME finance, corporate finance, wealth management, debt capital markets and loan syndication.
 
 What makes an ideal ABC Citizen? 
At ABC, we are constantly on the lookout for individuals who resonate with our 5 core values of Speed, Passion, Integrity, Seamlessness and commitment and live them every day, while also understanding our vision. We believe in building leaders who thrive on challenges, take the onus of creating and sustaining strong teams, and forms strong networks as a result of effective relationship-building.
 
 Role Details: 
 
 Business Aditya Birla Capital Unit Aditya Birla Finance Limited Location Chennai Role Business Analyst Department Mid-market & SCF Eligibility Criteria Masters in Finance, 3-4 Years of Relevant Experience 
 Required Skills & Competencies 
 
 To research and analyse credit risk for Mid-Market cases through existing due diligence processes, external agency support and in conjunction with the sales staff and risk team To assess credit history and approve/ deny extension of credit to potential commercial customers To keep the house keeping under control i.e. timely renewals, tracking of DPDs (for the assigned portfolio) To prepare proposals for approved cases and work in collaboration with sales and risk teams to ensure sanction limits and enable quick TATs To develop and maintain positive business relationships with dealers, commercial customers and sales staff. To assist less experienced Credit Analysis team members with Mid - Market on credit policy issues and commercial underwriting negotiations

The key responsibilities include initial screening of the proposal, thorough appraisal of credit proposals with the required due diligence; coordination with the sales team for resolution of credit and risk concerns, maintaining Turn Around Time (TAT); interfacing with the Sales team for faster decisions; Assist in Anchor program reviews.

Analyzes financial statements, collateral, debt service, personal financial statements and personal cash flow, as applicable to the size and complexity of the commercial transaction. Prepares, evaluates & underwrites finance proposals Implements & ensures adherence to credit policies and processes Strategizes & sees through the policy/ industry / market changes & implements the same in underwriting decisions Facilitates faster deal closures through proactive participation in deal structuring & credit enhancement Maintain desired TATs for deal processing by collaborating actively with sales, risk and operations teams Carries out personal discussions with clients for underwriting loans for Mid - Market when required Works with the CAD and sales teams to ensure effective and complete loan documentation Liaises with risk/ legal department on non-standard documents and/or exceptions to policy to ensure loan sanction process runs smoothly and compliantly

Supporting Actions:

Stakeholder Management 
Supporting Actions:

Develops and maintains strong business relationships with sales team members to ensure sales volume objectives and credit quality are both balanced and achieved Challenges sales/ business functions on high risk cases Supports quick closure / STP [ Straight through processing] for clean cases in collaboration with the Risk & operations teams Manages and seeks support from CPA [ Certified Public Accountants] and provides appropriate training related to organization compliance policies and processes Collaborates effectively with external agencies (Legal, Technical and Verification) for reports and opinions and to ascertain credit ratings / history for specific potential credit cases and existing loan customers. 
Post Sanction Surveillance Operations
Supporting Actions:
 Reviews and analyzes various transactions for existing customers including Review and analysis of applications Study of financial statements, balance sheets, business and customer bureaus Review of security and legal documents Study of credit history and payment performance Performs annual/ ad hoc reviews on portfolios and individual transactions and routinely monitors loans for compliance with loan agreements/ financial covenants. 
 
Credit Analysis Capability Building 
Supporting Actions:

Serves as subject matter expert and mentor for less experienced commercial credit analysts. ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

title: Senior Demand Planning Analyst / Consultant
description:
Role Summary Plan Optimus is looking for an experienced Demand Planning Analyst / Consultant with 4+ years of hands-on experience working with leading supply chain planning platforms such as Blue Yonder, o9 Solutions, or Kinaxis . The ideal candidate should have strong functional knowledge of demand forecasting, statistical forecasting, demand planning processes, and Integrated Business Planning (IBP). The candidate will work closely with our product development, implementation, and customer-facing teams to design, enhance, configure, and support the Plan Optimus Demand Planning solution. This role requires an individual who can independently understand business planning requirements, translate them into functional specifications, work with technical teams, and contribute to building a competitive enterprise demand planning platform. Key Responsibilities 1. Demand Planning Solution Design & Development Work with the Plan Optimus product development team to design and enhance demand planning capabilities. Translate business requirements into functional specifications, workflows, configuration requirements, and solution designs. Apply experience from Blue Yonder, o9, or Kinaxis to recommend industry-standard demand planning features and best practices. Define planning workflows, business rules, calculations, exceptions, and KPIs. Participate in solution testing, validation, and product enhancements. 2. Demand Forecasting & Analytics Support statistical forecasting, baseline forecasting, and demand forecasting processes. Understand forecasting methods, including moving averages, exponential smoothing, trend, seasonality, and machine learning-based forecasting. Analyze forecast accuracy, forecast bias, MAPE, WMAPE, and other demand planning KPIs. Support demand sensing, promotional planning, new product introductions, and product cannibalization analysis. Assist in developing exception-based planning and demand planning dashboards. 3. Demand Planning Configuration & Implementation Configure demand planning parameters, planning hierarchies, time buckets, and business rules. Support demand planning implementations, enhancements, and ongoing application support. Understand demand planning data requirements, including sales history, product hierarchies, customer hierarchies, promotional events, and external demand drivers. Collaborate with technical teams on data integration, validation, and planning calculations. Troubleshoot functional issues and recommend improvements. 4. Business Analysis & Customer Engagement Conduct requirement-gathering sessions with customers and business stakeholders. Understand existing demand planning processes and identify opportunities for improvement. Prepare functional requirement documents, solution design documents, test scenarios, and user acceptance testing plans. Conduct solution demonstrations, user training, and workshops. Work independently as a Demand Planning Subject Matter Expert (SME). 5. Product Development & Cross-Functional Collaboration Collaborate with software developers, data engineers, data scientists, and optimization specialists. Provide functional inputs for AI-enabled demand planning, scenario planning, and exception management. Work with Supply Planning, Inventory Planning, and S&OP teams to ensure integrated planning capabilities. Participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies, sprint planning, and product backlog prioritization. Mentor junior analysts and support knowledge sharing. Must-Have Skills 4+ years of experience in Demand Planning , including hands-on experience with at least one of the following:
 Blue Yonder Demand Planning o9 Solutions Demand Planning / Integrated Business Planning Kinaxis RapidResponse / Maestro Demand Planning Strong understanding of demand forecasting, statistical forecasting, and demand planning business processes. Experience configuring, implementing, enhancing, or supporting enterprise demand planning applications. Ability to translate business requirements into functional specifications and technical requirements. Experience with demand planning hierarchies, forecasting parameters, planning workflows, and exception management. Good understanding of forecast accuracy metrics, including MAPE, WMAPE, and forecast bias. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and troubleshooting skills. Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and working knowledge of SQL. Experience working with software development teams in Agile/Scrum environments. Strong communication, documentation, and stakeholder-management skills. Ability to work independently and take ownership of functional deliverables. Good-to-Have Skills Experience with Integrated Business Planning (IBP), Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP), Supply Planning, or Inventory Optimization. Experience in CPG, Food & Beverage, Retail, Quick Service Restaurants (QSR), or Distribution industries. Exposure to AI/ML-based demand forecasting and predictive analytics. Knowledge of Python, SQL, Snowflake, or modern data analytics platforms. Experience with promotional forecasting, demand sensing, new product forecasting, and cannibalization. Understanding of scenario planning, what-if analysis, and exception-based planning. Experience participating in product development for enterprise planning software. Experience conducting customer workshops, solution demonstrations, and user acceptance testing. Educational Qualifications Undergraduate: B.E. / B.Tech, B.Sc, B.Com, BBA, or equivalent qualification. Preferred: MBA in Operations / Supply Chain Management, Master's in Supply Chain Management, Industrial Engineering, or related disciplines. Ideal Candidate Profile We are particularly interested in candidates who have worked as Demand Planning Functional Consultants, Business Analysts, Solution Consultants, or Product Analysts on Blue Yonder, o9, or Kinaxis implementations. The candidate should have a strong understanding of how enterprise demand planning solutions work, including their business processes, configuration capabilities, planning workflows, and analytical features. This is primarily a functional and techno-functional role, not a pure software development position. Candidates should be comfortable collaborating with developers to translate supply chain planning requirements into software capabilities.

Key Skills: Demand planning,Ibp,Maestro,Supply chain planning,Sales,Consulting,Functional consultancy,Demand forecasting

Maintain the integrity and stability of QA and other testing environments throughout the project lifecycle. Participate in internal defect triage meetings, assess defect severity and priority, and coordinate with relevant stakeholders for resolution. Support customers during User Acceptance Testing (UAT), including test execution, defect investigation, retesting, and UAT defect triage. Perform post-deployment smoke testing and validate critical business functionality following releases. Communicate testing progress, defect status, risks, and quality metrics to project stakeholders. Adapt to customer-specific processes and delivery requirements while maintaining established QA standards and best practices. Work independently and collaboratively with globally distributed teams in a remote delivery environment, with flexibility to accommodate different time zones as required. Maintain target billable utilization in accordance with organizational and project expectations. Required Skills and Qualifications Minimum of 5 years of experience in Software Quality Assurance (QA) . Minimum of 3 years of hands-on experience with the Salesforce platform . Strong understanding of software testing methodologies, QA principles, and best practices. Hands-on experience in functional testing, regression testing, integration testing, and end-to-end testing. Good understanding of Salesforce objects, fields, relationships, validation rules, workflows, Flows, profiles, roles, permission sets, and sharing rules. Strong understanding of Agile/Scrum methodologies and experience working in an Agile delivery environment. Experience in the complete Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC), from requirements analysis and design through testing, deployment, and maintenance. Ability to create effective test plans and test cases based on written specifications, user stories, acceptance criteria, and verbal requirements. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with excellent attention to detail. Proven ability to identify, isolate, document, and track defects effectively. Familiarity with test automation concepts, framework design, and regression automation best practices. Knowledge of source code management, version control systems, deployment processes, and test environment management. Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Ability to work independently, manage priorities, and collaborate effectively with cross-functional and global teams. Strong organizational skills and the ability to deliver quality outcomes within tight sprint timelines. Preferred Qualifications Salesforce certifications relevant to the role. Scrum or Agile certifications, such as Certified ScrumMaster (CSM) or equivalent. Hands-on experience with test automation tools and frameworks. Experience in automation framework design, reusable test components, and continuous integration/continuous delivery (CI/CD) processes. Experience supporting Salesforce implementations, customer-facing projects, and UAT activities. Familiarity with API testing, integration testing, and data validation techniques. title: Senior Demand Planning Analyst / Consultant
description:
Role Summary Plan Optimus is looking for an experienced Demand Planning Analyst / Consultant with 4+ years of hands-on experience working with leading supply chain planning platforms such as Blue Yonder, o9 Solutions, or Kinaxis . The ideal candidate should have strong functional knowledge of demand forecasting, statistical forecasting, demand planning processes, and Integrated Business Planning (IBP). The candidate will work closely with our product development, implementation, and customer-facing teams to design, enhance, configure, and support the Plan Optimus Demand Planning solution. This role requires an individual who can independently understand business planning requirements, translate them into functional specifications, work with technical teams, and contribute to building a competitive enterprise demand planning platform. Key Responsibilities 1. Demand Planning Solution Design & Development Work with the Plan Optimus product development team to design and enhance demand planning capabilities. Translate business requirements into functional specifications, workflows, configuration requirements, and solution designs. Apply experience from Blue Yonder, o9, or Kinaxis to recommend industry-standard demand planning features and best practices. Define planning workflows, business rules, calculations, exceptions, and KPIs. Participate in solution testing, validation, and product enhancements. 2. Demand Forecasting & Analytics Support statistical forecasting, baseline forecasting, and demand forecasting processes. Understand forecasting methods, including moving averages, exponential smoothing, trend, seasonality, and machine learning-based forecasting. Analyze forecast accuracy, forecast bias, MAPE, WMAPE, and other demand planning KPIs. Support demand sensing, promotional planning, new product introductions, and product cannibalization analysis. Assist in developing exception-based planning and demand planning dashboards. 3. Demand Planning Configuration & Implementation Configure demand planning parameters, planning hierarchies, time buckets, and business rules. Support demand planning implementations, enhancements, and ongoing application support. Understand demand planning data requirements, including sales history, product hierarchies, customer hierarchies, promotional events, and external demand drivers. Collaborate with technical teams on data integration, validation, and planning calculations. Troubleshoot functional issues and recommend improvements. 4. Business Analysis & Customer Engagement Conduct requirement-gathering sessions with customers and business stakeholders. Understand existing demand planning processes and identify opportunities for improvement. Prepare functional requirement documents, solution design documents, test scenarios, and user acceptance testing plans. Conduct solution demonstrations, user training, and workshops. Work independently as a Demand Planning Subject Matter Expert (SME). 5. Product Development & Cross-Functional Collaboration Collaborate with software developers, data engineers, data scientists, and optimization specialists. Provide functional inputs for AI-enabled demand planning, scenario planning, and exception management. Work with Supply Planning, Inventory Planning, and S&OP teams to ensure integrated planning capabilities. Participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies, sprint planning, and product backlog prioritization. Mentor junior analysts and support knowledge sharing. Must-Have Skills 4+ years of experience in Demand Planning , including hands-on experience with at least one of the following:
 Blue Yonder Demand Planning o9 Solutions Demand Planning / Integrated Business Planning Kinaxis RapidResponse / Maestro Demand Planning Strong understanding of demand forecasting, statistical forecasting, and demand planning business processes. Experience configuring, implementing, enhancing, or supporting enterprise demand planning applications. Ability to translate business requirements into functional specifications and technical requirements. Experience with demand planning hierarchies, forecasting parameters, planning workflows, and exception management. Good understanding of forecast accuracy metrics, including MAPE, WMAPE, and forecast bias. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and troubleshooting skills. Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and working knowledge of SQL. Experience working with software development teams in Agile/Scrum environments. Strong communication, documentation, and stakeholder-management skills. Ability to work independently and take ownership of functional deliverables. Good-to-Have Skills Experience with Integrated Business Planning (IBP), Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP), Supply Planning, or Inventory Optimization. Experience in CPG, Food & Beverage, Retail, Quick Service Restaurants (QSR), or Distribution industries. Exposure to AI/ML-based demand forecasting and predictive analytics. Knowledge of Python, SQL, Snowflake, or modern data analytics platforms. Experience with promotional forecasting, demand sensing, new product forecasting, and cannibalization. Understanding of scenario planning, what-if analysis, and exception-based planning. Experience participating in product development for enterprise planning software. Experience conducting customer workshops, solution demonstrations, and user acceptance testing. Educational Qualifications Undergraduate: B.E. / B.Tech, B.Sc, B.Com, BBA, or equivalent qualification. Preferred: MBA in Operations / Supply Chain Management, Master's in Supply Chain Management, Industrial Engineering, or related disciplines. Ideal Candidate Profile We are particularly interested in candidates who have worked as Demand Planning Functional Consultants, Business Analysts, Solution Consultants, or Product Analysts on Blue Yonder, o9, or Kinaxis implementations. The candidate should have a strong understanding of how enterprise demand planning solutions work, including their business processes, configuration capabilities, planning workflows, and analytical features. This is primarily a functional and techno-functional role, not a pure software development position. Candidates should be comfortable collaborating with developers to translate supply chain planning requirements into software capabilities.

Key Skills: Demand planning,Ibp,Maestro,Supply chain planning,Sales,Consulting,Functional consultancy,Demand forecasting
