The primary responsibility of this role will be to manage end-to-end recruitment activities, including candidate sourcing, screening, interview coordination, and onboarding for various positions across multiple locations in Kerala. In addition to recruitment, the candidate will support monthly payroll operations, attendance and leave management, statutory compliance, and general HR administration. The ideal candidate should have strong communication and coordination skills, practical experience in recruitment, and a basic understanding of payroll and HR operations. Key Responsibilities 1. Recruitment and Talent Acquisition Manage end-to-end recruitment activities for various positions across multiple locations in Kerala. Source candidates through Naukri job portals, employee referrals, social media, and other suitable recruitment channels. Screen resumes and shortlist candidates based on job requirements, qualifications, experience, and suitability. Coordinate interview schedules with candidates, hiring managers, and internal stakeholders. Communicate with candidates regarding interview schedules, feedback, selection status, and joining dates. Maintain recruitment trackers, candidate databases, and hiring status reports. Coordinate with recruitment consultants and external agencies to fulfil manpower requirements. Support offer rollouts, salary discussions, candidate follow-ups, and joining confirmations. 2. Prepare and maintain employee documentation, personnel files, and HR databases. Coordinate employee induction and ensure a smooth onboarding experience. Follow up with selected candidates and hiring managers to ensure timely joining. 3. Assist in preparing salary structures, salary break-ups, payslips, and payroll reports. Support bonus and gratuity calculations in accordance with applicable rules and company policies. Maintain payroll trackers and employee salary records while ensuring accuracy and confidentiality. 4. Attendance and Leave Management Monitor and maintain employee attendance and leave records. Follow up with respective locations for the timely submission of attendance data. Verify attendance discrepancies, leave adjustments, and payroll-related inputs. Prepare attendance summaries and leave reports for monthly payroll processing. 5. Statutory Compliance and HR Operations Support employee enrolment and documentation related to Provident Fund (PF) and Employees State Insurance (ESI). Assist with ESI contribution calculations, challan preparation, filing, and related documentation. Maintain statutory records and employee compliance documents. Assist in preparing HR reports, payroll trackers, and other management reports. Respond to employee queries related to payroll, attendance, onboarding, and HR policies. Proficiency in MS Excel and MS Office. Knowledge of VLOOKUP, XLOOKUP, IF functions, and Pivot Tables will be an advantage. Good verbal and written communication skills. Strong organizational, coordination, and time-management skills. Ability to handle confidential employee information and meet deadlines. Ability to coordinate effectively with employees, hiring managers, recruitment consultants, and teams across multiple locations. Preferred Candidate Profile Experience in handling recruitment for Non-IT, Sales, B2B, Retail, or other business operations recruitment will be an advantage. Candidates with experience in both recruitment and payroll/HR operations are preferred. Experience recruiting for sales executives, showroom staff, business development professionals, and other operational roles will be an added advantage. title: Associate-Model Risk Management
description:
Company Profile Morgan Stanley is a leading global financial services firm providing a wide range of investment banking, securities, investment management and wealth management services. The Firm's employees serve clients worldwide including corporations, governments and individuals from more than 1,200 offices in 43 countries. As a market leader, the talent and passion of our people is critical to our success. Together, we share a common set of values rooted in integrity, excellence and strong team ethic. Morgan Stanley can provide a superior foundation for building a professional career - a place for people to learn, to achieve and grow. A philosophy that balances personal lifestyles, perspectives and needs is an important part of our culture. Department Profile The cornerstone of Morgan Stanleys risk management philosophy is the execution of risk-adjusted returns through prudent risk-taking that protects Morgan Stanley’s capital base and franchise. Risk Management protects the firm from exposure to losses resulting from market volatilities and defaults by our lending and trading counterparties. Background on the Position Morgan Stanley’s Model Risk Management (MRM) department resides within Morgan Stanley’s Firm Risk Management Division. Morgan Stanley’s global MRM team, spread across New York, London, Mumbai and Budapest is broadly responsible for the risk management of all of the Firm’s models involving model validation, risk assessment, and governance and act as an effective second line of defence within the Firm. Morgan Stanley is seeking a strong candidate to be a member of the MRM team in Mumbai, focused on the review, validation and risk assessment of models and tools on Traded Risk including, but not limited to VaR, FRTB IMA, RNIV etc. Primary Responsibilities The primary responsibilities of the role include, but are not limited to the following: Provide independent review and validation compliant with MRM policies and procedures, regulatory guidance and industry leading practices, including evaluating conceptual soundness, quality of model methodology, model limitations, data quality, and on-going monitoring of model performance Take initiatives and responsibility of end-to-end delivery of a stream of Model Validation and related Risk Management deliverables Write Model Review findings in validation documents that could be used for presentations both internally (model and tool developers, business unit managers, Audit, various global Committees) as well as externally (Regulators) Verbally communicate results and debate issues, challenges and methodologies with internal audiences including senior management Represent MRM team in interactions with regulatory and audit agencies as and when required Follow financial markets & business trends on a frequent basis to enhance the quality of Model and Tool Validation and related Risk Management deliverables. Qualifications Skills required (essential / preferred) Masters or Doctorate degree in a quantitative discipline such as Statistics, Mathematics, Physics, Computer Science or Engineering is essential Experience in a Quant role in validation of Models, in developments of Models or in a technical role in Financial institutions e.g. Developer, is essential Strong written & verbal communication skills including debating different viewpoints and making formal presentations of complex topics to a wider audience is preferred 4-6 years of relevant work experience in a Model Validation role in a bank or financial institution Proficient programmer in Python ; knowledge of other programming languages like R, Scala, MATLAB etc. is preferred Willingness to learn new and complex topics and adapt oneself (continuous learning) is preferred Working knowledge of statistical techniques, quantitative finance and programming is essential; good understanding of various complex financial instruments is preferred Knowledge of popular machine learning techniques is preferred Relevant professional certifications like CQF, CFA or progress made towards it are preferred Desire to work in a dynamic, team-oriented, fast-paced environment focusing on challenging tasks mixing fundamental, quantitative, and market-oriented knowledge and skills is essential

Familiarity with AI-powered discovery platforms such as Azure AI Search, ElasticSearch, OpenSearch, or similar technologies. Experience with knowledge management, content taxonomy, and metadata design. Exposure to GenAI, Copilot, conversational AI, and agent ecosystems.

Remain hands-on with development and debugging rather than functioning solely as a people manager. Establish engineering standards, development practices, testing protocols, and release processes. Make pragmatic technology decisions that balance long-term scalability with ad-hoc business requirements.

description:
Process Transformation & Technology Specialist - Finance and Procurement Business Operations- Transformation 
 Function 
Finance & Procurement Business Operations 
 Scope 
Accounts Payable (AP), Accounts Receivable (AR), Intercompany, Master Data Management, Procurement Operations and Service desk Transformation.

 Position Summary 
Process Transformation & Technology Specialist plays a critical role in driving operational excellence and transformation initiatives across global Finance and Procurement functions. The role is responsible for identifying, designing, and implementing process improvements, automation solutions, and operating model enhancements that improve efficiency, controls, stakeholder experience, and business outcomes.
Working across Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Intercompany, Master Data, and Procurement processes, this position partners closely with Finance and Procurement Operations, Shared Services, Controllership, Business Teams, and Digital Technology organizations to translate strategic priorities into scalable, measurable solutions.

 Key Responsibilities 
 Transformation & Process Excellence 
 Lead and deliver transformation initiatives across AP, AR, Intercompany, Master Data, and Procurement in alignment with the broader Finance Transformation roadmap. Analyze current-state processes, identify root causes and inefficiencies, and design future-state solutions that improve service delivery, controls, compliance, and efficiency. Drive process standardization, simplification, and harmonization across regions while balancing local regulatory and business requirements. Develop business cases, process maps, operating procedures, requirements documentation, test scenarios, and deployment plans. Identify opportunities to improve transaction quality, cycle times, working capital performance, and overall process effectiveness. Support implementation activities including user acceptance testing, defect resolution, cutover planning, and post-go-live stabilization. 
 Digital Transformation & Automation 
 Partner with technology teams and process owners to evaluate, prioritize, and deploy automation and workflow solutions. Leverage process mining, process intelligence, and analytics capabilities to identify improvement opportunities and measure outcomes. Support implementation of digital technologies including SAP Signavio, SAP Build Process Automation, Microsoft Power Platform, AI-enabled tools, and workflow technologies. Drive adoption of analytics and reporting solutions using Power BI, Databricks, and related platforms. Explore and implement practical AI and machine learning use cases to improve knowledge management, decision support, transaction processing, and operational efficiency. Ensure automation solutions incorporate appropriate governance, controls, auditability, data quality standards, and ownership frameworks. 
 Stakeholder Management & Change Leadership 
 Facilitate workshops, process reviews, design sessions, and governance forums with key stakeholders. Build alignment across Finance, Procurement, Shared Services, Technology, and Business teams to support successful transformation outcomes. Develop communication plans, training materials, operating procedures, and change management strategies. Manage risks, dependencies, and escalations while ensuring stakeholder engagement and adoption. Promote a culture of continuous improvement through Lean, Six Sigma, and best-practice methodologies. 
 Governance, Controls & Performance Management 
 Maintain project governance artifacts including project plans, risk registers, issue logs, action trackers, dependency logs, and benefits realization frameworks. Provide regular executive-level reporting on delivery progress, milestones, risks, adoption, and value realization. Ensure solutions remain compliant with finance policies, internal controls, audit requirements, regulatory obligations, and governance standards. Monitor post-implementation performance and drive corrective actions when expected outcomes are not achieved. Contribute to the development of transformation playbooks, methodologies, standards, and reusable assets. 
 Required Qualifications 
 Education 
 Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Commerce, Business Administration, or a related discipline. MBA, Master's degree, PGDBA, or equivalent postgraduate qualification preferred. Lean Six Sigma, PMP, Agile, Change Management, or other transformation certifications preferred. 
 Professional Experience 
 8+ years of experience in Finance Operations, Shared Services, Global Business Services (GBS), Procurement Operations, or Management Consulting. Minimum 3 years of experience leading or supporting finance transformation, process improvement, automation, or operating model initiatives. Demonstrated experience managing cross-functional projects across multiple business units, regions, or stakeholder groups. Strong knowledge of Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Intercompany Accounting, Master Data, and Procurement processes. Experience with SAP ECC and/or SAP S/4HANA environments. Practical experience in process mapping, business requirements definition, operating model design, and implementation support. Experience working with reporting and analytics tools such as Power BI, Excel, Databricks, or equivalent platforms. Automotive, manufacturing, or OEM industry experience strongly preferred. 
 Core Competencies 
 Business Process Expertise 
 Strong understanding of end-to-end AP, AR, Intercompany, Procurement, and Master Data processes. Knowledge of operational KPIs, service levels, controls, compliance requirements, and financial performance drivers. Transformation & Continuous Improvement 
 Proven ability to convert business challenges into scalable process, technology, and operating model solutions. Expertise in process reengineering, root-cause analysis, and continuous improvement methodologies. Data & Analytics 
 Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data, identify trends, and measure business outcomes. Ability to develop insights that drive operational improvements and decision-making. Relationship Management 
 Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence without direct authority. Excellent communication and presentation capabilities across operational and leadership audiences. Governance & Controls 
 Understanding of internal controls, audit frameworks, risk management, segregation of duties, and compliance requirements. Ability to ensure transformation initiatives balance efficiency gains with a strong control environment. 
 Success Measures 
 Success in this role will be measured through: 
 Successful delivery of transformation initiatives within agreed scope, timeline, and budget. Improvements in process efficiency, automation adoption, cycle times, and service quality. Increased straight-through processing and reduction of manual effort, exceptions, and rework. Improvements in working capital metrics including invoice cycle times, DSO, aging, unapplied cash, and intercompany reconciliation performance. Improved master data quality, governance adherence, and turnaround times. Sustainable governance, controls compliance, and audit readiness. 
 Preferred Technology Landscape 
 SAP S/4HANA and SAP ECC SAP Signavio (Process Mining, Process Insights, Process Modeling) SAP Build Process Automation (SAP BTP) SAP MDG and SAP GRC SAP Joule / SAP Business AI Microsoft Power Platform (Power BI, Power Apps, Power Automate) Microsoft Copilot and Copilot Studio Databricks KNIME Analytics Platform OpenText Workflow Solutions Intercompany Accounting Systems (IAS) SharePoint and Enterprise Collaboration Platforms

title: Senior Principal Platform Engineer - QA
description:
Job Purpose 
 The Senior Principal Platform Engineer - QA will help shape and evolve the organisations quality engineering platform, enabling teams to build, test, deploy and operate software faster, more securely, and more reliably. The QA role will set the testing and quality standards helping to build test automation that can be adopted across platform and application teams. They will also mentor the engineers around them, and treats the teams who consume the test automation as customers. The role works through infrastructure-as-code and golden paths rather than manual configuration, uses AI-assisted engineering across code generation, review and testing, and engineers reliability in by defining SLOs, instrumenting for observability and automating away toil. Engineering roadmap and direction sit with the Engineering Director, reference architecture and standards sit with the Platform Architect, backlog order sits with the Product Owner, and deep reliability engineering sits with the Site Reliability Engineer deployed from Reliability Engineering Operations. 
 
 Key responsibilities 
 
 Quality strategy and architecture 
 Define the platform quality engineering strategy, test pyramid and quality gates for all cloud platform products. 
 
 Continuous verification and automation 
 Build shift-left quality into CI/CD: automated gates for security, compliance, cost and drift before merge and release. 
 
 GxP and computerised system assurance 
 Modernise qualification from document-heavy validation to risk-based, automated Assurance. 
 
 Images, supply chain and security quality 
 Own test frameworks for VM, OS, database and container image bakeries: CIS benchmarks, vulnerability thresholds, SBOM and signing checks. 
 
 AI and agentic platform quality 
 Define evaluation frameworks for platform AI agents: accuracy, safety guardrail. 
 
 Engineering leadership 
 Set quality metrics and SLOs, report them to platform and security leadership, and drive corrective actions. 
 
 Required experience and skills 
 15+ years in software or platform engineering, with 3+ years leading quality or test engineering for tenant platforms at enterprise scale. Deep hands-on Terraform experience Strong policy-as-code skills around OPA/Rego Production experience on Azure and GCP; working knowledge of Kubernetes and GitOps Built CI/CD quality gates in GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps or similar. Proficient in at least one of Python, Go or TypeScript for test frameworks and tooling. Experience in a regulated industry (life sciences, pharma, finance or healthcare), including GxP or equivalent validation. Track record of setting technical direction across multiple teams without direct authority. 
 
 Preferred qualifications 
 Experience testing LLM-based or agentic systems Familiarity with software supply chain standards: SLSA, SBOM (SPDX/CycloneDX), Sigstore/cosign. Chaos engineering tools such as Azure Chaos Studio, LitmusChaos or Gremlin. Experience with Red Hat Ansible Automation Platform, Azure Arc or hybrid estates. Certifications such as Azure Solutions Architect Expert, Google Professional Cloud Architect, ISTQB Advanced or CKA. 
 
 Leadership behaviours and ways of working 
 Quality as an engineering discipline: builds automation and paved roads, not manual sign-off queues. Risk-based judgement: scales testing rigour to patient, product and data-integrity impact. Influence without authority: aligns platform, security, Quality and GRC stakeholders on shared standards. Hands-on credibility: writes and reviews code, and can debug a failing pipeline alongside the team. Clear communicator: turns quality data into decisions for senior leadership and auditors alike.

Job Purpose: This role is responsible to lead portfolio-wide execution and governance across strategic product and technology programs. The role provides a single senior orchestration point across Business, Product, Engineering, QA, Production Support, Cloud / Infrastructure, InfoSec, Operations, Risk, Compliance, Finance and partners. The incumbent must combine strong subject command with executive presence, structured problem solving and the authority to challenge commitments, resolve cross-functional conflicts and drive timely decisions. 
 Key Responsiblities: 
 a) Portfolio strategy translation: Convert approved business and product priorities into an integrated execution plan, with outcomes, milestones, dependencies, decision points, investment needs and accountable owners. 
 b) Executive stakeholder management: Build trusted relationships with senior Business and Technology leaders. Frame issues clearly, align divergent viewpoints, secure decisions and maintain confidence through fact-based, proactive communication and tracking with proper timelines and RCAs as applicable. 
 c) Integrated planning and prioritization: Lead, fortnightly, monthly, quarterly and rolling planning across product pillars. Reconcile capacity, regulatory commitments, business-critical dates, technical dependencies and vendor plans; expose trade-offs for leadership decision. 
 d) Governance and decision architecture: Design and chair reviews, SteerCos and escalation forums. Ensure each forum has a clear purpose, accurate inputs, decision rights, actions, owners and closure discipline. 
 e) Delivery assurance: Independently assess programme health beyond reported RAG status. Validate critical path, milestones, resource assumptions, quality gates, readiness and benefits dependencies. 
 f) Cross-programme dependency management: Identify shared services, platform, data, API, security, infrastructure and partner dependencies; assign ownership and resolve sequencing conflicts before they affect delivery. 
 g) Risk, issue and escalation management: Maintain an executive RAID view, drive mitigation and trigger escalation at the right point. Distinguish decisions, risks, issues, assumptions and dependencies; prevent silent slippage. 
 h) Commercial and vendor governance: Govern delivery obligations, milestones, resource commitments, change requests, SLA performance, commercials and escalations for implementation and managed-service partners. 
 i) Financial governance: Track approved business cases, programme budgets, forecasts, purchase dependencies, change costs and benefit assumptions in partnership with Finance and procurement owners. 
 j) Release and operational governance: Ensure major releases have business, QA, Engineering, security, infrastructure, support and rollback readiness. Review recurring incidents, RCA closure and stability actions without taking over functional ownership. 
 k) Regulatory and audit readiness: Ensure traceability of mandatory commitments, approvals, evidence, controls, risks and closure for regulatory, compliance and audit programmes. 
 l) Capability and standards: Establish consistent planning, status reporting, RAID, dependency, release-readiness and decision-log standards. Coach Program Managers to become outcome-led leaders rather than coordinators. 
 Requirements: 
 Bachelors degree in Engineering, Technology, Business, Finance or a related discipline; postgraduate qualification is desirable. Programme / project certification such as PMP, PRINCE2, SAFe, Scrum or equivalent is desirable, but demonstrated delivery leadership is more important than certification alone. Proven leadership of multiple, concurrent, high-complexity programmes involving business, product, engineering, operations and external partners. Strong understanding of lending journeys and lifecycle, including acquisition, underwriting, disbursement, servicing, collections, customer channels and partner integrations. Working command of agile, hybrid and milestone-based delivery; ability to challenge plans, dependencies, solution assumptions and release readiness. Experience with executive governance, programme financials, vendor contracts, implementation partners, risk management and organisational change. Ability to understand architecture, APIs, data flows, environments, security, cloud / infrastructure and production support sufficiently to ask the right questions and drive accountable closure. Experience in regulated financial services is strongly preferred.
